tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /sum cu pa dang rtags kyi 'jug pa'i tshig don gsal bar byed pa'i snang ba zhes bya ba bzhugs/

na mo gu ru mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ tshogs gnyis chu gter chen po las 'khrungs shing*/ /bden gnyis chos tshul nyams len mthar phyin te/ /sku gnyis mngon du gyur nas rang gzhan gyi/ /don gnyis lhur mdzad ston pa de la 'dud/ /rab yangs shes bya'i mkha' la thogs med rgyu/ /ye shes zer gyis 'gro ba'i blo mun sel/ /mtha' dag bstan pa'i pad tshal bzhad pa'i gnyen/ /'jam mgon smra ba'i nyi mas dge legs stsol/ /gang de'i sgyu dra mi yi srid pa'i tshul/ /bod yul mkhas pa'i thog ma thon mi zhes/ /dam chos 'dzin pa'i ched du mngon byon pa/ /chos blon chen po sambho tra der 'dud/ khyod gsung mdzod kyi dgongs don yid bzhin nor/ /skal ldan 'dod pa'i re ba bskong ba'i ched/ /tshig 'grel rgyal mtshan rtse mor mngon mchod kyis/ /legs bshad don gnyer mchis na 'dus shig kye/ /de la 'dir sum cu pa dang rtags kyi 'jug pa'i tshig don 'chad pa la gnyis kyi dang po la lnga/ /mdzad pa po'i khyad par/ phyogs gang du gtogs pa/ /mtshan gang yin/ gzhung gi tshad/ tshig don bshad pa dngos so/ /dang po ni/ chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i chos blon chen po rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rnam 'phrul thu mi sambho tra'am thon mi saṃ bho ra zhes grags pa des mdzad pa'o/ /thu mi ni rus kyi ming yin la/ sambho tra ni bod yang dag pa'i don du mang pos bshad cing*/ kha cig /sa 'bor ra zhes kyang zer ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ rig gnas lnga las sgra rig pa'i khongs su gtogs so/ /gsum pa la gnyis/ dngos dang 'phros so/ /dang po ni/ bstan bcos 'di'i mtshan la ci zhe na/ rgya gar gyi skad du/ byā ka ra ṇa mū la triṃ shatna ma zhes bya la/ de nyid bod kyi skad du bsgyur na/ lung du ston pa sum cu pa'i rtsa ba zhes bya bar 'gyur te/ byā ka ra ṇa ni lung du ston pa/ mū la ni rtsa ba/ triṃ shad ni sum cu pa/ nā ma ni zhes bya bar 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/

/de yang gang lung du ston na/ sgra'i mtshan nyid ston pa'i phyir te/ /kā li sum cu po rgya cher ston pas so/ /sum cu pa zhes pa'i don kyang de nyid yin la/ kha cig sho lo ka sum cu yod pas/ sum cu pa zhes rnam grangs tsam du bshad do/ /gnyis pa smra ba'i dbang phyug 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal zhes pa'i 'gyur phyag ni/ lotstsha bas bkod pa ste/ rgya gzhung dngos min kyang*/ /de dang 'dra bar khungs btsun par bstan pa sogs kyi ched do/ /bzhi pa ni/ sho lo ka so gsum du grangs nges so/ /lnga pa la gsum/ bstan bcos la 'jug pa'i sgo bshad pa/ 'jug bya bstan bcos kyi rang bzhin bshad pa/ /mjug tu bsdu ba'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ /mchod par brjod pa dang*/ /bshad par dam bca' ba'o/ /dang po la rim pa bzhi yod pa las/ dang po ni/ gang la yon tan mchog mnga' ba'i/ /dkon mchog de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa ste/ don ni/ /gang zhes pa spyi sgra yin kyang*/ /'dir bye brag la 'jug ste/ 'og gi tshig dang 'brel ba'i dkon mchog la 'jug pa'i phyir ro/ /la ni nges bzung gi don ces zer yang*/ rnam dbye bdun pa la bya ste/ dkon mchog ni yon tan de'i gnas gzhi yin par bstan pa'i phyir/ 'chad pa ltar yon tan mchog mnga' ba'i dkon mchog ces spyir smos kyang sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun gsum ka la bya zhing*/ rim pa bzhin du don gnyis mthar phyin pa dang*/ 'gog lam dang*/ rig grol gyi yon tan dang ldan pa'o/ /de zhes pa nges bzung yin te/ bshad ma thag pa'i dkon mchog de nyid nges bzung ba'i ched du yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'dir la zhes smos pa ni/ dgos ched kyi tshig yin la/ phyag 'tshal zhes pa ni/ 'dud pa'i don te/ lo ni slar bsdu ba ste/ don de re zhig rdzogs par ston pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ gang gis sgra dbyangs gsungs pa yi/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa ste/ gang ni spyi sgra yin kyang*/

bye brag 'jam dbyangs la bya zhing*/ gis zhes pa ni byed pa'i sgra ste/ des sgra dbyangs ā li sngon gyi dus su bstan pa'i phyir ro/ /des na de ltar gsungs pa yi 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo zhes so/ /'jam pa ni gsung 'jam pa dang*/ thugs nyon mongs pa'i rtsub reg dang bral ba la'ang bshad do/ /gsum pa ni/ gang gis ming gzhi sngon gsungs pa'i/ /rtag zhi ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa ste/ gang gis ni gong gi rigs pas go zhing*/ /ming gzhi kā li sngon gyi dus su thog mar gsungs pa'i rtag zhi ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes so/ /'dir rtag zhi ba ni/ zha lu chen pos/ sangs rgyas la bzhed pa ltar snang la/ rnam gling pa sogs 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug dang*/ kha cig tshangs pa dang*/ gzhan dag khyab 'jug la bzhed kyang*/ re zhig rnam gling pa sogs kyi ltar bya'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ sdeb sbyor legs mdzad mkhas rnams dang*/ /bla ma la yang phyag 'tshal nas/ zhes pa ste/ sngon 'phags yul du byon nas sgra dang snyan dngags dang sdeb sbyor la sogs pa'i rig gnas rnams legs par dar bar mdzad pa'i slob dpon dpa' bo dang*/ tsant+ra gau mi dang*/ rin chen 'byung gnas zhi ba sogs mkhas pa rnams dang der ma zad slob dpon rang nyid la drin du che ba'i bla ma lha rig pa'i seṅge dang*/ yig mkhan li byin sogs la'ang phyag 'tshal lo/ /nas zhes pa ni 'dir 'tshams sbyar ba ste/ de ltar bstod nas ci bya zhe na/ 'og ma 'chad pa'i 'brel btsal pa'o/ /gnyis pa bshad par dam bca' ba ni/ bslab pa kun gyi gzhi 'dzin cing*/ /rig byed smra ba rnams kyi rgyu/ /ming tshig brjod pa kun gyi gzhi/ /zhes rang bzhin brjod nas/ yi ge'i sbyor ba bshad par bya/ zhes rtsom par dam bcas so/ /lhag pa tshul khrims dang*/ ting 'dzin dang*/ shes rab kyi bslab pa ste/ bslab pa kun gyi gzhi 'dzin par byed cing nges brjod dang mchod sbyin dang srid srung dang snyan ngag ste rig byed smra ba rnams kyi'ang rgyu yin la/

mdor na ming dang tshig tu brjod pa kun gyi gzhir gyur pa ni yi ge yin pas/ 'dir de'i sbyor ba bdag gis bshad par bya'o zhes so/ /gnyis pa 'jug bya bstan bcos kyi rang bzhin la gnyis/ yi ge'i rnam gzhag rgyas par bshad pa dang*/ ming tshig gi 'jug pa bstan pa'o/ /dang po la gsum/ bod yig so bzhi bshad pa/ sngon 'jug rjes 'jug mi 'jug pa gsum bstan pa/ de nyid rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ cung zad rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ yi ge ā li kā li gnyis/ /zhes pas ston te/ bod kyi yi ge'i dbang du byas na ā li ste dbyangs yig gi phreng ba dang*/ kā li ste gsal byed kyi phreng ba gnyis su yod do zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ ā li gsal byed i sogs bzhi/ /kā li sum cu tham pa'o/ /zhes pas ston te/ ā li de gang zhe na/ ngag tshig gsal bar byed pa'i i sogs te u e o'i yi ge bzhi yin la kā li de yang gang zhe na/ ka nas a'i bar sum cu tham pa 'byung ba rnams so/ /de yang*/ rgya gar gyi yi ge la dbyangs bcu bzhi'am/ gzhan nas 'byung ba bsnan pas bcu drug yod la gsal byed ni so gsum mo/ /gzhan nas bshad pa'i yi ge kṣas kha bskang na so bzhir yang snang ngo*/ /'dir dbyangs kyi yi ge la dbri ba dang*/ gsal byed la dbri bsnan gnyis mdzad cing*/ dbyangs dang po ni gsal byed du byas so/ /de yang dbyangs ā ī ū ṛ ṝ l̥ l̥̄ ai au rnams dang*/ gzhan nas 'byung ba'i aṃ aḥbacas dor te/ i sogs bzhir nges par mdzad do/ /gsal byed kyi gha dzha ḍha dha bha rnams dang*/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ṇa rnams dang*/ gzhan gyi yi ge kṣa rnams bri ste/ lhag ma rnams ky-i steng du bod skad la mkho ba stod du ca cha ja gsum/ smad du zha za 'a gsum ste drug bsnan to/ /der ma zad/ rgya yig la ni/ wa sgos su mi snang bas 'di yang bsnan zer te brtag /'o na 'dir bod yig la dbyangs bzhi dang*/

gsal byed sum cu bshad pa'i phyir/ bod yig sum cu rtsa bzhir 'gyur bas/ de lta na thu mi nyid kyi zhal nas/ rgya yig lnga bcu tham pa de/ /bod yig sum cur gtan la phab/ /ces bshad pa dang 'gal lo zhe na/ mi 'gal te/ dbyangs kyi i sogs bzhi dang bcas na/ de ltar yin kyang*/ bzhi po de gi gu zhabs kyu 'greng bu na ro bzhir 'gyur bas na yan lag yin gyi/ gtso bo min zhing dbye bsdu tsam yin pas so/ /gnyis pa ni/ de las rjes 'jug bcu yin te/ de las lnga ni sngon du'ang 'jug /mi 'jug pa ni nyi shu'o/ /zhes pa ste/ ji skad bshad pa'i ka sogs gsal byed kyi yi ge sum cu po de las/ ga nga da na ba ma 'a ra la sa ste rjes 'jug gi yi ge bcu yin te/ bcu po de las ga da ba ma 'a lnga po ni/ rjes su 'jug par ma zad sngon du'ang 'jug la/ de dag gi lhag ma ka kha ca cha ja nya ta tha pa pha tsa tsha dza wa zha za ya sha ha a rnams 'dir sngon rjes gang du'ang mi 'jug pa ni nyi shu zhes bya ste/ de rnams kyis ming gzhi tsam byed kyi ming gzhi'i sngon rjes gang du'ang 'jug pa min pa'i phyir ro/ /'o ni rdzogs tshig ste sdud pa'i don no/ /gsum pa rgyas par bshad pa la gsum/ sde tshan las rjes 'jug dbyung ba/ de las sngon 'jug dbyung ba/ mi 'jug pa'i yi ge nyi shu po bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ kā li phyed dang brgyad sde ni/ /bzhi bzhi dag tu phye ba la/ /dang po gsum pa bzhi pa yi/ /mas gnyis drug pa'i gsum pa dang*/ /bdun pa la ni sha ma gtogs/ /rjes 'jug yi ge bcu ru 'dod/ /ces pa ste/ kā li ste gsal byed kyi 'phreng ba sum cu po de yang phyed dang brgyad kyi sde tshan du gnas shing*/ de yang ni bzhi tshan bzhi tshan dag tu phye ba la/ sde ba dang po ni/ ka kha ga nga*/ gnyis pa ni/ ca cha ja nya/ gsum pa ni/ ta tha da na/ bzhi pa ni/ pa pha ba ma/ lnga pa ni/ tsa cha dza wa/ drug pa ni/ zha za 'a ya/ bdun pa ni/ ra la sha sa rnams dang*/

brgyad pa ni/ ha a gnyis bcas phyed dang brgyad du tha snyad byas nas/ sde pa'i dang po ka sde/ gsum pa ta sde/ bzhi pa pa sde gsum po yi mas kyi gnyis te/ ga nga*/ da na/ ba ma rnams dang*/ drug pa zha sde'i gsum pa 'a yig dang*/ bdun pa ra sde la ni bar gyi sha yig ma gtogs pa'i ra la sa gsum ste/ de dag gi rjes 'jug gi yi ge bcu ru 'dod pa yin no// gnyis pa ni/ rjes 'jug yi ge bcu po las/ /dang po gsum pa lnga pa drug /bdun pa rnams ni sngon du'ang 'jug /ces pa ste/ bshad ma thag pa'i rjes 'jug gi yi ge bcu po de dag las/ dang po ga gsum pa da lnga pa ba drug pa ma bdun pa 'a yig ste lnga po ste 'di rnams ni rjes su 'jug par ma zad sngon du'ang 'jug go /gsum pa ni/ ming gzhi gnyis sam gsum sbrel lam/ /de la dbyangs kyi bzhi ldan yang*/ /gang du'ang 'jug min sbyar ba'ang min/ /zhes pa ste/ gong du brjod pa'i ka la sogs pa ming gzhi kho na'i yi ge nyi shu pa de dag ni/ sngon rjes su mi 'jug par ma zad/ tsheg bar gcig tu/ kakha dang*/ cacha lta bu gnyis sam khachanya/ patsawa lta bu gsum sbrel lam/ de lta bu la ni dbyangs kyi yi ge i sogs bzhi po gang rung dang ldan pa yang dper na/ kazhi/ cachu zhes dang*/ khachinya/ patsuwa zhes pa lta bu 'byung srid na'ang*/ thon mi bdag gis ni/ bod kyi yi ge la brten pa'i gsung rab kyi tha snyad gang du'ang 'jug par byas pa min zhing brda sbyar ba'ang min no zhes so/ /'dir kha cig tu dbyangs kyi gzhir zhes 'byung ba ni ma dag par gsal lo/ /gnyis pa ming tshig gi 'jug pa bshad pa la gnyis/ rnam dbye gtso bor bshad pa/ dgar bsnan 'byed sdud bshad pa'o/ / dang po la lnga/ rnam dbye dang po dang 'brel ba slar bsdu bshad pa/ rnam dbye gnyis pa sogs dang 'brel ba la sgra bshad pa/ rnam dbye drug pa bshad pa/ rnam dbye gsum pa dang rgyan sdud sogs bshad pa/ rnam dbye lnga pa dang dgar bsnan sogs bshad pa'o/

/dang po ni/ rjes 'jug yi ge bcu po ni/ /ming gang gi ni mthar sbyar ba/ /de la ā li bzhi pa sbyar/ /slar bsdu bar ni shes par bya/ /zhes pas ston te/ rjes 'jug yi ge bcu po de ni/ ming gang yang rung ba dag gi ni mthar sbyar ba de la ā li bzhi pa o yin sbyar ba ni/ don de re zhig rdzogs par ston pa ste/ de'i tha snyad la slar bsdu ba zhes bya bar ni shes par bya'o/ /de yang*/ ga sogs rim pa bzhin du dper brjod na/ 'di ni rtag go / mthong ngo*/ /yod do/ /yin no/ /btab bo/ /bsam mo/ /mkha' 'o/ /'gyur ro/ /dal lo/ /shes so zhes dang*/ da drag gi stobs kyis phyin to/ /gyur to/ bsal to/ /zhes pa lta bu rnams 'das tshig yin pas da drag thob/ da drag 'di na ra la gsum gyi rjes su 'thob par 'gyur gyi/ gzhan dag la ni min no/ kha cig /rtag go /'byung ngo*/ 'dod do/ ston no/ 'don no zhes pa lta bu ni/ slar bsdu tsam po ba yin gyi/ dngos min pa lta bu zhig bzhed kyang*/ 'thad pa ni ma mthong ste/ tsam po ba yin min gyi don/ slar bsdu khyad par can min pa'i don du 'dod na/ 'di ni rtag go zhes pa dang*/ rtag go zhes pa sogs la khyad par can yin min dbye dka' la/ dngos yin min la byed na ni shin tu mi 'thad de/ de lta na/ mi tsam po ba yin na/ mi ma yin pas khyab par thal bar 'gyur ba sogs mang ngo*/ /rnam dbye dang po'i mtshan gzhi ni/ rtag pa/ mi rtag pa/ sa/ chu/ me/ rlung*/ nam mkha' zhes sogs rang ming nas brjod pa phal cher yin la/ de yang*/ rgya skad la rnam dbye dang po dang ming gi khyad par gsal zhing*/ bod skad la de gnyis khyad par cher med par bshad do/ /'on kyang*/ rtag go zhes sogs ni/ rnam dbye dang po'i don gsal bar ston pa la bya'o/ /de'i don sdom du mdzad pa ni/ rdzogs tshig skabs su rjes 'jug bcur/ rang 'dar rna ru sbyar ba dang*/ da drag can mthar ta dang ni/ skabs 'gar ba yi rjes su pa/

/zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ rjes 'jug yi ge bcu po las/ /gang ming mtha' na bcu pa gnas/ /de la ā li gnyis pa sbyar/ /gang ming mtha' na brgyad pa gnas/ /de la gnyis pa u yang sbyar/ /gang ming mtha' na gsum pa gnas/ /de la a li gnyis pa sbyar/ /bzhi pa dgu pa dngos rkyang ste/ /las dang ched dang rten gnas dang*/ /de nyid tshe skabs la sgra yin/ /zhes gsungs te/ rjes 'jug gi yi ge bcu po las/ gzhi gang yang rung ba'i ming gi mtha' na rjes 'jug gi bcu pa sa yig gnas na/ de la ā li gnyis pa u yig sbyar bas su dang*/ gang yang rung ba'i ming gi mtha' na brgyad pa ra yig gnas na de la dbyangs kyi yi ge gnyis pa u yang sbyar bas ru dang*/ gang yang rung ba'i ming gi mtha' na rjes 'jug gsum pa da yig gnas pa na/ de la a li gnyis pa u sbyar bas du dang*/ rjes 'jug bzhi pa na dang*/ dgu pa la yig ni/ ā li bzhi po gang rung ma sbyar bar na dang la yig dngos rkyang pa dang*/ shugs bstan dang da drag gi mthar tu zhes 'byung ba yod pas de rnams ni skabs kyi dbye bas/ rnam dbye gnyis pa las su bya ba dang*/ bzhi pa dgos ched de dang bdun pa rten gnas dang nges bzung gi de nyid dang*/ dus kyi tshe skabs ston par la'i sgra dang don mthun du 'jug pa yin no/ /'dir gang ming mtha' na brgyad pa gnas/ /de la gnyis par u yang sbyar/ zhes 'byung ba ltar byas na/ cung mi bde bas/ de la gnyis pa u yang sbyar/ zhes sbyor ba ni legs par mthong ngo*/ /de ltar na rnam dbye gnyis pa las su bya ba'i dper brjod ni/ shar phyogs su 'gro/ /g.yas su 'gro/ ngos su rgyugs/ steng du song*/ 'og tu ltos/ nang du 'chug /phyir ru gyur/ 'dir ru sdod/ mkha' la bgrod/ mkha' ru 'gro/ /rgyab tu gos gyon/ mig tu sman blug /snod du sha btsos/ shar la 'phur/ mdun du bgug /sa la drud/ shing la gzhog /thog tu bris/ gdong la phyis/ stegs la zhogs/

gdan la nyol/ g.yon na dgod zhes sogs lta bu ste/ 'di la bya ba 'das ma 'ongs da lta gsum ston pa 'byung zhing*/ byed pa bdag dang ma 'ongs gnyis ka'ang ston pa 'ong ngo*/ kha cig /bsam du med/ gsal du btang*/ dbang bskur du gsol zhes pa lta bu rnams gnyis pa las kyi sgra yin par bzhed pa ni 'thad dam mi 'thad brtag par bya ste/ de'i snga ma gnyis ni/ de nyid la 'jug pa'am gzhi de yin par sgrub pa'i sgrar gtogs pa ni/ dper na/ sangs rgyas su gyur/ lhar gyur/ mir gyur/ gcig tu song*/ so sor grub sogs dang phyogs 'dra ba'i phyir dang*/ phyi ma ni dgos ched du bya snyam ste/ dpyad par bya'o/ /bzhi pa dgos ched ni/ sangs rgyas la mchod/ chos kyi ched du phul/ dge 'dun gyi phyir du phyin/ bu la nor ster/ nad la sman/ bkres la zas/ skom la chu byin nam/ ster dgos/ 'tshang rgya ba'i ched du'am/ phyir du'am/ rgya ba la tshogs gsog /sems can thams cad kyi ched du/ de'i phyir du/ de'i don la chos kyis/ gson la rim gro/ gshin la chos sam dge ba/ mkhas par 'gyur ba la dpe ltos/ mgron du'am/ de la 'gro/ ston mor 'gro/ khyod la bkra shis shog /'di ru bde legs shog ces pa lta bu'o/ kha cig shar phyogs su mchod pa phul zhes pa ni/ bzhi pa dgos ched du bzhed kyang*/ las su bya ba nyid du 'gyur bar sems/ bdun pa gnas gzhi ni g.yas su bzhugs so/ /sa la gnas/ de la yod/ de ru mchis/ sangs rgyas la yon tan mnga'/ shing la bya/ phyug po la nor yod/ steng du lha dang bla ma/ dbus su rgyal po/ mdun du blon po/ grwal du mi tshogs bsdad/ mkha' la nyi zla/ rgyab tu gos/ phrag tu rgyal mtshan/ lam du shing rta/ 'og na dmyal ba yod ces pa lta bu dang*/ de nyid la 'jug pa ni/ g.yon du mthong*/ yin du nges/ bsam du med/ gsal du btang*/ rtag tu dga'/ kun tu 'thad/ gtan du gyur/ mgon du grub ces pa lta bu dang*/ lha de kho na nyid/

lha de nyid/ lha de rang zhes pa lta bu yang de nyid la 'jug pa'i sgrar bshad do/ /yang de'i dus na dang*/ de'i tshe na/ de'i skabs la lta bu ni dus kyi bdun pa'i sgrar bshad pas/ gsal du btang*/ bsam du med/ dbang bskur du gsol lta bu ni las su bya ba'i phyogs gtogs dang*/ de nyid la 'jug pa gnyis ka'ang yin zhes byas na/ 'gal mi 'gal brtag /tshe skabs la 'jug pa ni/ snga dro'i dus su/ phyi dro'i dus la/ de'i dus na zhes dang*/ nyin phyed du song*/ nyi shar du nye/ dpyid du sleb/ nyi ma shar na nam langs la zhes pa lta bu ste phyi ma 'di rgyu mtshan ston pa'i tshe skabs so/ /sdom ni/ sa su ga ba da drag tu/ /nga da na ma ra la du/ /'a dang 'dogs can rkyang pa ru/ /'di dang ra mtha' bya ba gcig /ces so/ /gsum pa ni/ rjes 'jug yi ge bcu po ni/ /i dang mthun lugs 'di zhes bya/ /dang po gnyis la dang po mthun/ /gsum lnga bcu la kya dang sbyar/ / bdun pa nyid la bdun pa ste/ lhag ma rnams la gya sbyar ba/ /de dag i sbyar 'brel ba'i sa/ /zhes pa ste rjes 'jug gi yi ge bcu po de ni/ ā li dang po i dang mthun lugs 'di zhes bya ste/ de yang rjes 'jug dang po ga dang gnyis pa nga gnyis yod pa'i mtha' can la rjes 'jug dang po/ ga la i sbyar ba gi zhes pa mthun la gsum pa da/ lnga pa ba/ bcu pa sa rnams la kya dang i sbyar ba dang*/ bdun pa nyid la bdun pa 'a la i sbyar ba 'thob ste/ rkang pa skong ba'i tshe ya la i sbyar ba'ang thob bo/ /de'i lhag ma na ma ra la rnams la gya sbyar ba la dbyangs i sbyar bas gyi zhes par 'gyur te/ mdor na/ sngar bshad pa'i ga kya 'a gya de dag la i ste gi gu sbyar ba ni/ rnam dbye drug pa 'brel ba'i sa'am sgra yin no zhes so/ /dper brjod ni bdag gi nor/ gdong gi ngos/ khyod kyi 'khor/ rgyab kyi gos/ g.yas kyi phyogs/ 'di'i zas zhes dang*/ rkang pa skong ba'i tshe yi'ang thob ste/

rnam grol 'bras bu 'tshal ba yi/ /zhes pa bzhin no/ /na ma ra la ni/ mdun gyi ngos/ gtam gyi tshul/ shar gyi phyogs/ dpal gyi bdag po sogs so/ /bdun pa nyid la bdun pa ste/ /zhes pa'i tshig zin ltar na 'a yi rjes su 'a yig gnyis pa dgos par bstan kyang*/ 'dir srog tu 'a yod pa dang 'a gcig gis gnyis ka'i go chod pa'i dbang du byas so/ /sdom ni/ da ba sa kyi ga nga gi /na ma ra la rnams la gyi/ /mtha' rten med mthar 'i dang ni/ /rkang pa skong tshe yi zhes sbyar/ /zhes so/ /bzhi pa rnam dbye gsum pa la bzhi/ byed sgra dngos bshad pa/ rgyan sdud bshad pa/ lhag bcas bshad pa/ 'byed sdud bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ de nyid la ni bcu pa sbyar/ /byed pa po ru shes par bya/ /zhes pa ste/ gong du brjod pa'i gi kyi 'i yi gyi zhes pa'i yi ge de dag nyid la ni rjes 'jug bcu pa sa yig sbyar ba ni/ byed pa po ston pa'i sgra ru shes par bya'o/ /dper brjod ni/ bdag gis chos byas/ gang gis shes/ khyod kyis bris/ rgyab kyis 'khur/ sangs rgyas kyis gsungs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'is zhes don du 'thob kyang skad gsar bcad du bsdus nas/ byang chub sems dpas shes dang*/ ngas mthong*/ des thos/ 'dis byas zhes sbyar ba dang*/ de yis gzigs dang*/ mkhas pa yis kyang mkhyen pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' yis ni mdzad ces dang*/ kun gyis rig /gtam gyis brjod/ gser gyis phug /zil gyis mnan sogs dang*/ da drag gi mthar/ rab 'byor gyis gsol/ kun mkhyen gyis bstan/ pha rol gyis thos zhes sogs dang*/ bdag gis tshig gis bltas/ khyod kyis stobs kyis byas/ /lag pas sta res shing bcad/ 'di yis bgyis pa'i las kyis byung zhes pa lta bu'ang 'ong srid pas/ de'i tshe byed pa gnyis byung yang gtso phal gyi khyad par yod do/ /'on kyang*/ chos gyis shig khrus gyis/ bag yod kyis/ don gyis/ mdor na/ khyod kyis las 'di dang 'di gyis shig ces pa lta bu rnam dbye ma yin te/

de dag gi byos shig pa'i don yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ ā li phyis nas gnyis pa sbyar/ /tshig rgyan gnyis dang sdud par 'gyur/ /zhes pa ste/ gong gi yi ge de rnams kyi nang nas gi gyi gnyis dor ba'i kyi 'i yi gsum gyi ā li i phyis nas rjes 'jug gi gnyis pa nga sbyar bas mthun pa dang mi 'thun pa'i tshig rgyan gnyis dang*/ sdud pa'i sgrar 'gyur ro/ / dper brjod ni/ mkhas kyang mkhas la shes kyang shes/ utpala'ang yin la sngon po'ang yin/ na ba'ang yin la sdug bsngala'ang che/ /lha yang yin la tshe yang ring*/ /zhes pa lta bu mthun pa dang*/ 'ching ba spangs kyang snying rjes bcings/ /'dam las skyes kyang des ma gos/ /bzhin ras dkar yang skra tshogs nag /chags sdang bral na'ang bdud rnams 'joms/ /zhes pa lta bu ni mi mthun pa'i tshig rgyan no/ /de dag phal cher snga phyi sdud pa'i tshig yin mod/ des kyang shes la ngas kyang mthong*/ /zhes pa dang*/ de yang yin la 'di yang min/ / zhes dang*/ de tsam shes pa lta yang ci/ /chos rnams kun kyang mngon du gyur/ zhes pa lta bu ni sdud pa'i tshig go /sdom ni/ ga ba da sa da drag mthar/ /kyang 'thob rjes 'jug gzhan mthar yang*/ /rkyang mthar 'ang dang skong tshe yang*/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa ni/ la don su la u phyis nas/ /de la gsum pa'i dang po sbyar/ /de la a li gsum pa sbyar/ /de ni lhag ma dang bcas pa'o/ /zhes pa ste/ la dang don mthun pa'i su la u yig phyis nas/ de la sde pa gsum pa ta sde'i dang po ta sbyar zhing*/ de la ā li gsum pa e sbyar ba de ni/ don de rdzogs par ma bstan par lhag ma dang bcas pa ston pa'i sgra'o/ /'dir sa ste dngos su bstan pa de dang te shugs la bstan par bya'o/ /dper brjod ni/ sngar song ste mthong*/ bzang ste srid/ mi rtag ste/ 'jig pa'o/ /rtag ste/ 'jig pa med pa'i chos yin pa'i phyir/ bden pa gnyis yod de/ kun rdzob dang*/ don dam

pa'o/ /yod pa yin te/ shes bya yin pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes pa lta bu ste/ mtshams sbyor ba'i lhag bcas dang*/ dam bcas pa'i lhag bcas/ gzhan 'dren pa'i lhag bcas ci rigs su 'gyur ro/ /sdom ni/ da de na ra la sa dang*/ /da drag can mthar te rkyang nyid/ /ga nga ba ma 'a rnams dang*/ /'dogs can rkang mthar sa ste'o/ /zhes so/ /bzhi pa ni/ rjes 'jug yi ge bcu po la/ /drug pa sbyar na 'byed sdud yin/ /zhes pa ste/ rjes 'jug gi yi ge bcu po gang dag /rjes 'jug gzhan gang gi mthar gnas pa la rjes 'jug gi drug pa ma yig sbyar na don 'byed pa dang sdud pa'i tshig tu 'gyur ba yin te/ dper na/ phung po ni/ gzugs sam/ tshor ba'am/ 'du shes sam/ 'du byed dam/ rnam par shes pa'o zhes dbye gzhi sngon la bkod nas dbye ba rjes su phye ba ni 'byed pa dang*/ mig gam/ rna ba'am/ sna 'am/ lce'am/ lus sam/ yid ni dbang po'o zhes pa lta bu/ dbye ba sngon du bkod nas dbye gzhir sdud pa ni sdud pa'i don no/ /rtag gam/ mi rtag ces pa lta bu dang yin nam/ min nam zhes pa'i the tshom mam dri ba rnams kyang 'byed sdud gang rung du bsdu bar bya'o/ /rjes 'jug so sor sbyor tshul ni/ rtag gam/ mthong ngam/ yod dam/ yin nam/ 'grub bam/ bsgom mam/ gda' 'am/ zer ram/ nyal lam/ shas sam/ lta bu dang*/ da drag gi mthar tam sbyar ba ni/ 'dzin tam/ 'phral tam/ gyur tam zhes pa lta bu ste/ sdom ni/ 'byed sdud skabs su rjes 'jug bcur/ rang 'drar ma yig sbyar ba yi/ /da drag can la ta dang sbyar/ /zhes so/ /lnga pa la gnyis/ rnam dbye lnga pa dngos nyid zhar byung rgyan sdud bcas bshad pa dang*/ rnam dbye brgyad pa bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rjes 'jug yi ge bcu po yi/ /bzhi pa dgu pa la bcu pa/ /sbyar ba 'byung khungs sa yin te/ / dgar dang sdud pa'ang de bzhin no/ /zhes pa ste/ rjes 'jug gi yi ge bcu po yi nang gi bzhi pa na yig dang*/

dgu pa la yig la bcu pa sa yig sbyar ba nas dang las zhes pa'i sgra ni rnam dbye lnga pa/ 'byung khungs kyi sa yin te dgar ba dang*/ sdud pa'ang de bzhin du sbyor ba yin no/ /zhes so/ /'byung khungs gyi dpe ni/ phu nas chu byung*/ ma las bu skyes/ tshogs las sangs rgyas 'grub/ sdig las sdug bsngal 'byung*/ ri las lhung*/ de las thob/ ces pa lta bu dang*/ dgar ba ni/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten las sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mchog /lha'i nang nas tshangs pa dang brgya byin gtso/ /rigs las rgyal rigs 'phags/ mdor na/ de las bzang ngam ngan/ de'i nang nas de mchog gam dman zhes pa lta bu dang*/ sdud pa ni/ gzugs nas rnam mkhyen gyi bar zhes dang*/ srid rtse nas mnar med kyi bar/ mgo nas rkang pa'i bar zhes pa lta bu ste/ 'di la las kyi sgra mi 'jug par bshad/ 'on kyang de la sogs pa zhes par de las sogs pa zhes 'byung ba ni sdud pa'i don no zhes bdag gi slob dpon bzhed do/ /'thad pa ltar snang yang*/ ngag sgron las/ ma dag pa'i phyogs su bshad pas brtag go /gnyis pa ni/ gang ming brjod pa'i dang po ru/ kye sbyar ba ni bod pa yin/ zhes pa ste/ gang yang rung ba'i ming brjod pa'i dang po ste thog ma ru kye zhes sbyar ba ni bod pa'i sgra yin te/ kye rgyal po/ kye rgyal ba'i sras/ kye lha/ kye mi khyod ces pa lta bu dang*/ de dang mthun par kwa ye mi zhes pa'ang snang ngo*/ /'on kyang*/ kye ma dang*/ kye hud ni de min no/ /bod pa ni/ 'dir 'bod pa'i sgra ste/ gzhi de la 'bod pa'i sgra'o/ /gnyis pa dgar brnan sogs bshad pa drug /ni sgra dang dang sgra/ de dang gang gi sgra 'jug tshul/ bdag po dang dgag sgra/ tshigs bcad 'grol ba'i man ngag /rjes 'jug med mi rung du bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ gang ming mtha' dang mthun pa yi/ /bzhi pa la ni i sbyar ba/ /dgar dang brnan pa'i tshig tu 'gyur/ zhes pa ste/ gang yang rung ba'i ming gi mtha' dang mthun pa yi rjes 'jug bzhi pa na yig la ni/

dbyangs i sbyar bas ni zhes 'byung ba'i sgra ni/ dgar dang brnan pa'i tshig tu 'gyur te/ dang po ni/ dper na/ byang chub sems dpa' las ni sangs rgyas mchog /byang sems rnams kyi nang nas ni 'jam dbyangs shes rab che zhes dang*/ 'di las ni de bzang ngam sogs dang de'i nang nas ni de nyid mchog go /zhes pa lta bu ste/ de yang nas dang las zhes pa'i dgar tshig gi grogs so/ /dgar ba'i don ni mang po 'am/ zla bo las dmigs kyis dgar ba ste/ yang 'di dag las gdong bzhi pa 'di ni tshangs pa'o/ /mig stong dang ldan pa 'di ni brgya byin no/ /mgrin sngon po 'di ni dbang phyug go zhes dang*/ chos rnams las 'di ni gzugs so/ /'di ni tshor ba'o zhes sogs lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyis chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ phan bde'i lam la ni bkod ces dang*/ tshogs ni bsags/ sgrib pa ni sbyangs/ yod ni yod/ shes ni shes/ mthong ni mthong zhes pa lta bu ste/ brnan pa'i don ni/ nges bzung lta bu nan tan du sbyar ba'o/ /gnyis pa dang sgra ni/ ming gang rung ba'i bar mtshams su/ gsum pa la ni gnyis pa sbyar/ /de ni sdud dang 'byed pa dang*/ /rgyu mtshan tshe skabs gdams ngag lnga'o/ /zhes pa ste/ ming gang yang rung ba'i bar mtshams su rjes 'jug gsum pa da yig la ni gnyis pa nga yig sbyar ba na nga zhes pa'i sgra de ni/ don du ma gcig tu sdud pa dang*/ gcig du mar 'byed pa dang rgyu mtshan dang tshe skabs sam dus ston pa dang*/ gdams ngag 'doms pa lnga la 'jug pa'o/ /lha dang mi dang*/ lha ma yin dang*/ dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten zhes dang gzugs dang*/ tshor ba dang*/ 'du shes dang*/ 'du byed dang*/ rnam shes ni phung po'o zhes pa lta bu dbye gzhi rjes su bkod pa ni sdud pa dang*/ chos gang yin pa de dang de/ 'di dang 'di rnams zhes pa lta bu yang sdud pa dang*/ phung po lnga ste/ gzugs dang*/ tshor ba dang*/ 'du shes dang*/

'du byed dang*/ rnam par shes pa'o lta bu dang*/ bden pa ni gnyis te/ kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i bden pa'o zhes la dpyad pa'i gzhi sngon du bkod pa ni 'byed pa'o/ / sgra ni mi rtag ste/ byas pa'i phyir dang*/ rkyen las byung ba'i phyir dang*/ skyes pa'i phyir dang zhes pa lta bu ni rgyu mtshan dang*/ nyi ma shar ba dang sleb/ nam langs pa dang 'gro/ mun rub pa dang nyal/ sangs rgyas pa dang sgrib pa spangs zhes pa lta bu ni tshes skabs sam dus dang bya ba mnyam du brjod pa'o/ /bdag gis brjod kyis nyon dang*/ 'di gyis dang*/ 'di la slobs shig dang*/ sgoms dang*/ sgrubs dang rnams gdams la 'jug pa'o/ /gnyis pa la go rim mi 'dra ba zhig snang yang 'dir gnyis te/ de sgra dang gang gi sgra bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ gang ming brjod pa'i ya mtha' ru/ /gsum pa la ni e sbyar ba/ /tha snyad dbang du gsum yin te/ /dngos po'i dbang du bzhi ru 'gyur/ /dus kyi dbang du gnyis yin no/ /zhes pa ste/ gang yang rung ba'i ming brjod pa'i ya mtha' ste thog ma ru rjes 'jug gi gsum pa da yig la ni dbyangs e sbyar ba de zhes bya ba'i sgra de ni/ tha snyad kyi dbang du byas na/ dus 'das pa dang rnam grangs gzhan dang lhag bcas te gsum la 'jug pa yin te/ dngos po'i dbang du bden pa dang gsang ba dang bdag gi ba dang pha rol po'i dngos po bzhi ru 'gyur ba dang*/ dus kyi dbang du byas na 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa'i dus gnyis la 'jug pa yin no/ /de'i tha snyad kyi dbang du byas pa'i 'das pa ni/ dus gsum gyi nang tshan gyi 'das pa tsam min gyi/ brjod zin gyi don 'das ma thag pa nyid go ba zhig ste/ ji skad bshad pa gang yin par dang de zhes dang*/ de nas dpal ldan rdo rjai 'chang*/ zhes dang*/ de yang rang*/ de rnams dang*/ de dag dang*/ de nyid dang*/ de sogs dang*/ de nas dang*/ de ma thag tu/ de lta bu sogs mang ngo*/ /rnam grangs gzhan ni/ blo'ang de yin/

rig pa'ang de yin/ sangs rgyas de chos kyang de/ tshig dang don gang yin pa de dang de 'di dang 'dir bshad par bya zhes pa lta bu dang*/ lhag bcas ni yod de/ med de zhes sogs lta bu'o/ /dngos po la 'jug pa bzhi'i bden pa'i don/ de bzhin nyid/ de kho na nyid/ de de bzhin sogs dang*/ de nyid ces pa la'ang 'jug srid do/ /gsang ba ni/ de nyid spang bar bya/ de bsgrag par mi bya/ de bstan par mi bya sogs rang tshig gis dngos su smos par gsang ste brjod pa zhig go /bdag gi ba la 'jug pa ni/ bdag gi de nga'i de/ bdag gi nor de/ nga'i chos de zhes pa dang*/ pha rol la 'jug pa ni/ khyod kyi de/ gzhan gyi de/ khyod kyi zas nor de/ khyod kyi yon tan de zhes pa lta bu sla'o/ /'di dag ni brda sngon du song bas brjod pa nyung ba dgos shing*/ skabs kyi don gtso mi gtso'i khyad par ma gtogs 'das pa'i don la 'jug pa ni mi 'gal bar mngon no/ /dus kyi dbang du byas pa gnyis ni/ 'das ma 'ongs kyi dus gnyis te/ sngon de'i tshe de'i dus na de dang der gyur to zhes pa lta bu 'das pa dang*/ phyis de'i tshe de'i dus na 'di dang 'di zhes bya bar 'gyur ro zhes pa lta bu ma 'ongs pa la 'jug go /gnyis pa gang ngam spyi sgra ni/ /gang ming brjod pa'i dang po ru/ /dang po la ni gnyis pa sbyar/ /spyi la khyab pa nyid du 'gyur/ /zhes pa ste/ gang yang rung ba'i ming brjod pa'i dang po ru/ rjes 'jug gi dang po ga la ni gnyis pa nga yig sbyar ba gang zhes pa'i sgra de ni/ don spyi la khyab pa'i sgra nyid du 'gyur te/ dper na/ gang zhig gzigs shing gsungs pa yis/ /zhes dang*/ gang gang rkyen la rag las pa/ /zhes pa lta bu ni spyi sgra yin no/ 'on kyang bye brag la 'jug pa yod do/ /gang dang gang yin pa de dang de/ /gang yin na 'di yin/ de dang mtshungs pa su yin/ ci yin sogs kyang spyi'i don la 'jug go /gsum pa la gnyis/

bdag sgra dang*/ dgag sgra'o/ /dang po ni/ gang ming brjod pa'i ma mtha' na/ /pu liṅga yi sgra med pa/ /de la pu liṅga sbyar na/ /bdag po'i sar ni shes par bya/ /zhes pa ste/ gang yang rung ba'i ming brjod pa'i ma mtha' na/ /pu ni/ pu ru ṣa zhes pa skyes bu'i ming gi thog ma yin la/ liṅga ni rtags sam mtshan ma la 'jug pas na/ pu liṅga ste pho rtags so/ /de'i sgra sngar med pa de la pu liṅga'i sgra sbyar na ni bdag po'i sar ni shes par bya ste/ dper na/ chos pa/ rta pa/ sangs rgyas pa/ mu stegs pa/ tshong pa/ ja pa/ tshwa pa zhes sogs/ de dang 'dra ba/ kha lo bsgyur ba/ long ba zhes dang*/ kha cig tu/ byed pa po/ tshong ba po/ mthong ba po/ shes pa po sogs dang*/ la lar ja ma/ chang ma/ yid 'ong ma sogs dang*/ yang*/ 'khor lo can/ mig can/ sems can sogs dang*/ yang*/ blo ldan/ shes ldan/ sems ldan/ chos ldan sogs kyis kyang bdag sgra ston par 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ gang ming brjod pa'i ya mtha' na/ st+ri liṅga yi sgra med pa/ /de la st+ri liṅga sbyar na/ /dgag pa'i gnas su shes par bya/ /zhes pa ste/ gang yang rung ba'i ming brjod pa'i ya mtha' 'am/ ma mtha' na yang rung ste/ der st+ri liṅga sta st+ri ni bud med kyi ming yin la/ de liṅga zhes sbyar ba na mo rtags zhes par 'gyur bas/ de yi sgra sngon med pa de la st+ri liṅga'i sgra sbyar ba na/ dgag pa'i sgra'i gnas su shes par bya'o/ /dper na/ mi sgrib pa/ mi skye ba/ mi 'byung ba/ mi rig pa/ ma shes pa/ ma go ba/ gzugs med/ tshor ba med/ 'du shes med/ yod pa min/ dngos po min/ rtag pa min sogs lta bu dang*/ sgrib pa dag /rang bzhin gyis stong*/ skyon dang bral/ chu bkag /yod pa dang yin pa la'ang*/ ce ste med ci ste min sogs mang ngo*/ /de dag bsdu na/ ma yin dgag dang*/ med dgag brjod pa'i sgra gnyis su 'du'o/ /dgag tshig zhes pa ni/ dgag bya 'gog pa'i tshig yin pa zhig la byed cing*/

de'i khyad par rgyas zhib tu spro nus kyang mang du dogs nas ma bris so/ /rtsa ba la yang*/ gang ming ni ya mtha' ru/ /zhes sogs rkang pa bdun po mtshams 'dir 'byung yang*/ 'grel pa rnams su ni sngar ltar ro/ /lnga pa ni/ tshigs su bcad pa'i mtshams sbyor rnams/ /cung zad bsdus pa yod na yang*/ /de ni de bzhin sbyar bar bya/ /zhes pa ste/ gsung rab rnams kyi tshig gsungs pa'i mtshams sbyor rnams las cung zad bsdus pa zhig yod na yang*/ bsdus pa de ni don ji ltar thob pa de bzhin du sbyar nas lhug par bgrol te bshad par bya'o/ /dper na/ rgyal sras byang sems nyan rang sogs/ /zhes pa lta bu la/ rgyal ba'i sras byang chub sems dpa' dang nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dang*/ sogs sgras gang yang gzhan 'dren par 'chad dgos pa bzhin no/ /drug pa ni/ sngon 'jug yod dam med kyang rung*/ /ming gzhi yi ge gang ldan pa'ang*/ /nyis sbrel yod dam sum sbrel yod/ /a li bzhi las gang 'brel yang*/ /rjes 'jug bcu po ma zhugs na/ /ming gzhan sbyor ba yod mi srid/ / ces pa ste/ bshad zin pa'i sngon 'jug lnga po gang rung der yod dam med kyang rung*/ ming gzhi'i yi ge sum cu po gang rung ldan pa yin pa la'ang*/ nyis sbrel yod dam/ ming gzhi kho na'i yi ge nyi shu po gang rung mthar gnas pa'i sum sbrel yod pa'am/ ā li bzhi po las gang dang 'brel yang rung*/ mthar rjes 'jug gi yi ge bcu po gang rung ma zhugs na ming gzhan gyi sbyor ba thu mi bdag gis bar sbyar ba'i gsung rab la nam yang yod mi srid do zhes so/ /'o na/ sa chu me sgra dri ro sna lce sogs kyi mthar rjes 'jug bcu po gang rung med kyang brda sbyor ba srid ce na/ skyon med de/ de dag la rjes 'jug dngos su mi sbyor yang*/ rjes 'jug gi 'a ni don gyis 'thob pas mi 'ga' ba'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa mjug bsdu ba la bzhi/ rjes 'jug shes pas mkhas par 'gyur tshul/

nyams su len tshul/ bslab tshul bstan pa/ bslab pa'i dus bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rjes 'jug bcu yi don shes na/ /'dri dang klog dang bshad rnams kyi/ /mtshams sbyor sgra la thogs med cing*/ /'brel bar smra ba'i mchog tu 'gyur/ /gzhan yang rjes 'jug shes pa yis/ /don gyi sbyor ba ma mthong yang*/ /don dang mthun pa'i sbyor ba shes/ /zhes pa ste/ sngar bshad pa'i tshul de ltar rjes 'jug bcu yi don gyi 'jug tshul shes na/ gsung rab sogs kyi yi ge 'dri ba dang*/ klog pa dang*/ gzhan la bshad pa dang*/ rtsom pa dang*/ rtsod pa la sogs pa'i gnas skabs su/ don/ tshig rnams kyi/ mtshams sbyor ba'i sgra smra ba la thogs pa med cing*/ tshig don go rim 'brel chags par smra ba'i mchog tu 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang rjes 'jug gi don gyi 'jug tshul shes pa yis/ gsung rab sogs kyi don gyi gnas 'byed pa'i sbyor ba 'grel pa sogs mthong yang*/ de'i dgongs don dang mthun pa'i tshig gi sbyor legs par shes nus so/ /'dir mtshams sbyor ni/ bya byed las gsum sbyor ba'i tshig zhig la byed do/ /de yang*/ rnam dbye tshig phrad rnams dang*/ bye brag mi mgo zhes pas rnam dbye drug pa bsdus pa dang*/ sangs rgyas mkhyen/ sangs rgyas mchod/ mtsho skyes/ sa gnas/ utpal sngon po/ ba khra mo can lta bus ni/ rim bzhin/ rnam dbye gsum pa bzhi pa lnga pa bdun pa rnams bsdus pa'i tshul dang*/ utpal dang sngon po'i gzhi mthun dang*/ ba khra mo yod pa'i bdag po 'am sa phyogs lta bu sdud pa sogs/ gzhan yang*/ gang gi phyir zhes pa dang*/ ci'i phyir la de'i phyir dang*/ ji snyed kyis de snyed/ ci ltar gyis de ltar dang gang gi chos de'i tshe dang*/ ci 'dras de 'dra sdud pa sogs dang*/ gang dang gang zhe na/ de dang de zhes pa dang*/ ste te cing zhing shing sogs sbyor tshul te/ mdor na/ de dag gi phrad sbyor tshul dang 'byed tshul legs par shes par 'gyur ro/

/brjod 'dod kyi khyad par las ma gtogs/ spyir 'di zhes pa don nye ba dang de zhes pa ring ba la 'jug kho na tsam 'ba' zhig sogs don gcig pa dang*/ nyid ces pa'ang kho na zhes pa dang 'dra ba'i skabs kyang yod cing gtso bo nges bzung dang*/ tshul ni/ 'dra ba dang*/ smad pa dang*/ thabs sogs la 'jug cing bzhin ni 'dra ba dang*/ ma nor ba'am yin pa la 'jug go /cing 'ga' zhig ni kyang zhes pa dang don mthun cing*/ kha cig ni mtshams sbyor ba'i tshig ste/ bcad cing gtub zhes pa lta bu'o/ /sgra'i mtshams sbyor chen po ni/ gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ rjes 'jug sbyor ba mkhas pa na/ lung gi don dang sbyor ba dang*/ bla ma'i man ngag gsum sbyar nas/ /don gyi thog tu dbab par bya/ /zhes pa ste/ rjes 'jug bcu'i sbyor ba mkhas par shes pa na bka' 'am bstan bcos kyi lung gi don dang phyin ci ma log par sbyor ba ste/ de rnams kyi don legs par shes pa dang*/ rjes 'jug dang*/ lung gi don shes pa gnyis kyi steng du bla ma'i man ngag bcas gsum po sbyar nas/ don gyi thog tu dbab par bya'o/ /gsum zhes pa'i don zha lu chen pos de ltar bzhed la/ rnam gling pas/ nang don rig pa dang*/ dngos stobs kyi rig pa gnyis kyi steng du bla ma'i man ngag bcas gsum la sbyor te/ de yang lung gi don dang sbyor ba gnyis so sor mdzad cing*/ don gyi thog tu zhes pa tshig gi don zhes spyi la bshad/ zha lu pas nyams len gyi snying po'i don la 'chad do/ /gsum pa ni/ bslab la brtson pa'i gang zag gis/ dang por nga ro rnams la sbyang*/ /sngon 'jug rjes 'jug ming gzhi gsum/ /klog gi ched du bslab pa yin/ /rjes 'jug bzhi yi sbyor ba ni/ /mnyan bsam bstan pa'i ched du sbyar/ /man ngag de dag mthu yis ni/ /'bras bu'i ched du gtan la dbab/ /bslab pa'i rim pa 'di yis ni/ /gang zhig 'bad pa chung ngus kyang*/ /shes rab myur du grol bar 'gyur/

de phyir dang por 'di nyid bslab/ /de nas rgyas pa'ang mnyan byas te/ /bslab pa gang la dad pa yi/ / gzhung nyid bla ma dag la mnyan/ /zhes pa ste/ bslab par bya ba'i gnas la brtson pa'i gang zag las dang po ba de dag gis dang po nga ro drang po ka la sogs pa rnams la rang rang gi 'byung gnas las legs par thon pa'i skad kyis sbyar bar bya zhing*/ des sngon 'jug dang rjes 'jug dang ming gzhi gsum gyi dbye bsdu sbyor tshul 'dir bstan pa ni/ klog gi ched du yin pas legs par bslab par bya dgos pa yin la/ bstan bcos phyi ma nas 'byung ba'i sngon 'jug dang rjes 'jug gnyis gang la 'jug /gang gis 'jug pa/ ji ltar 'jug pa/ ci'i phyir 'jug pa bzhi yi sbyor ba ni/ bla ma la chos mnyan pa dang*/ don rang nyid kyis bsam pa dang*/ gzhan la bstan par bya ba'i ched du sbyar ba yin pas/ yan lag gam man ngag de dag gi mthu yis ni/ thob bya 'bras bu'i ched du gsung rab kyi don rnams gtan la dbab par bya'o/ /de lta bu bslab pa'i rim pa 'di yis ni/ don gnyer can gyi skyes bu gang zhig 'bad pa chen po lta ci byung dus kyang de'i shes rab ni rmongs pa las myur du grol bar 'gyur ro/ /rgyu mtshan de'i phyir na/ mkhas par 'dod pas dus dang por gong du bshad pa'i bslab pa'i rim pa 'di nyid la bslab par bya zhing de nas brda sprod pa'i gzhung rgyas pa'ang mnyan par byas te/ lhag pa tshul khrims ting nge 'dzin/ shes rab kyi bslab pa gsum gang la rang nyid dad pa yi gzhung nyid bla ma dag la mnyan par bya'o/ /gong gi nga ro zhes pa'i don ni/ ka sogs dang*/ de rnams la dbyangs bzhi sbyor tshul la bya zhing*/ de yang mtshon na/ ka'i gu gu ki /ka'i zhabs kyu ku/ ka'i 'greng bu ke /ka'i sna ro ko zhes sogs dang*/ ga 'og ca/ gca'i zhabs kyu gcu/ gcu la gas gcugs zhes pas mtshon nas nga ro rnams la bslab par bya'o gsung*/ 'on kyang nga ro klog tshul ni mtha' gcig tu ma nges te/

ka gi gu ki sogs dang*/ ka ya bdags kya sogs dang*/ gca zhabs kyu gcu/ gas bzhag gcugs sogs rang rang gi yul skad kyi brjod tshul sna tshogs pa zhig 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /bzhi pa ni/ slob dpon de nyid du 'dzin cing*/ /le lo g.yeng ba rnam par spang*/ /zo bzang dad pa la brten pa/ skyes bu des ni myur rtogs te/ /de la dus su 'doms par bya/ /cig shos de las ldog pa'o/ /zhes pa ste/ las dang po pas gzhung 'di la bslab pa'i tshe khengs pa med par slob dpon de nyid du 'dzin cing*/ le lo dang g.yeng ba rnam par spang bar bya la brtson 'grus kyis zo bzang ba ste zo mdog gam rang bzhin bzang ba bzhin mdangs 'dzum pa dang bcas pas 'jug cing*/ dad pa la brten pa'i skyes bu des ni/ don myur du rtogs par 'gyur te/ de ni rgyun du 'jug par spro ba'i rtags sbyor dang*/ dad cing 'jug pa'i gus sbyor gyi brtson 'grus gnyis dang ldan pa'i phyir ro/ /des na gang zag de la don du gyur ba'i phyir na dus su 'doms par bya zhing*/ sngar bshad pa las bzlog pa'i cig shos le lo can ni 'doms tshul sngar bshad pa de las ldog pa'i sgo nas btang snyoms su bya'o/ /yang na/ de las ldog pa ni/ le lo can las ldog pa'i don du bshad par bya ste/ 'on kyang*/ kho bo ltar na/ cig shos zhes pas sngar bshad pa'i le lo can dang mi dad pa'i zlog phyogs bstan nas/ de las ldog ces pas sngar gyi 'chad tshul gyi ldog phyogs bstan par sems so/ /skabs 'dir/ de ltar bshad des de nas 'dir/ /kun gyis de ltar rtogs gyur cig /ces 'byung ba'i don ni zha lu chen po'i 'grel par mi snang bas mkhan po'i gzhung du mi bzhed par sems la/ rnam gling pas smon lam du bzhed do/ /gsum pa ni/ byā ka ra ṇa'i rtsa ba sho lo ka sum cu pa zhes bya ba slob dpon a nus mdzad pa rdzogs so/ /zhes 'byung ba ni go sla zhing*/

a nu zhes pa ni kha cig yab kyi mtshan du bzhed kyang*/ slob dpon rang nyid kyi mtshan du byas tshe/ rgya skad yin na/ rjes su zhes pa zhig thob la/ bod skad yin na rus sam yul skad du bya dgos par sems so/ /zhes bya ba ni sum cu pa'i tshig don bshad pa'o/ /gnyis pa rtags kyi 'jug pa la gsum/ slad kyi don/ gzhung gi don/ mjug gi don no/ /dang po la gsum/ mtshan/ 'gyur phyag/mchod brjod do/ /dang po ni bstan bcos 'di'i mtshan ci zhe na/ yod de/ rgya gar na skad rigs chen po bzhi yod pa las/ legs sbyar gyi skad du/ 'di'i mtshan la/ byā ka ra ṇa liṅgā ba tā ra nā ma zhes 'byung zhing*/ de nyid bod skad du/ lung du ston pa rtags kyi 'jug pa zhes bya bar 'gyur ba'i phyir te/ gzhan rnams sngar bzhin la/ liṅga ni rtags dang ā ba tā ra ni 'jug pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ smra ba'i dbang phyug 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa ste sla'o/ /gsum pa ni/ smra ba'i skyes mchog smra ba'i rgyal/ /thams cad mkhyen la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa ste/ grub mtha' 'am brjod pa smra ba'i skyes bu thams cad kyi mchog dang*/ smra ba'i rgyal por gyur pa chos thams cad mngon sum du mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes so/ /gnyis pa gzhung gi don la gsum/ ming gzhi'i yi ge so so'i rtags kyis bya ba/ sngon 'jug gi rtags kyi 'jug pa/ rjes 'jug gi rtags kyi 'jug pa bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ pho yi yi ge 'ba' zhig la/ /sde pa phyed dang brgyad gnas pa'ang*/ /sde tshan lnga ru dril byas la/ /yi ge sum cu tham pa la/ /pho mo ma ning gsum du dbye/ /pho dang ma ning mo dang ni/ /shin tu mo dang bzhi bzhi ru/ /sde pa bzhi pa yan chad dbye/ /lhag ma bcu bzhi gnas pa la/ /tsa sogs gsum ni ca sogs sbyar/ /wa ni ba dang sbyar bar bya/ /lhag ma drug ni mo ru sbyar/ /ra la ha ni mo gsham ste/ /ma ning mtshan med ces kyang bya/

/zhes pa ste/ spyir gsal byed kyi yi ge pho dang*/ dbyangs mo yin pas/ 'dir pho yi yi ge gsal byed 'ba' zhig ste kho na la/ sde pa phyed dang brgyad du gnas pa'ang*/ dgos pa'i sgo nas sde tshan lnga ru dril bar byas te bshad par bya ba la/ de yang pho dang*/ ma ning dang*/ mo dang*/ shin tu mo dang*/ mo gsham mam ma ning mtshan med bcas lnga ste/ ka la sogs pa'i yi ge sum cu tham pa la nang tshan gyis/ pho mo ma ning gsum du dbye zhing*/ pho dang ma ning mo dang ni shin tu mo dang bzhi bzhi ru ni/ sde pa bzhi pa pa sde yan chad la rim par dbye bar bya'o/ /dbye tshul ni rim pa bzhin du/ dang po ka sde'i dang po ka pho/ kha ma ning*/ ga mo/ nga shin tu mo dang*/ de bzhin du/ gnyis pa ca ste/ gsum pa ta sde/ bzhi pa pa sde yan chad la sbyar te/ ca ta pa ni pho/ cha tha pha ni ma ning*/ ja da ba ni mo/ nya na ma ni shin tu mor dbye bar byas la/ lhag ma yi ge bcu bzhi gnas pa la/ tsa sogs te tsha dza gsum ni ca sogs te cha ja gsum po dang sbyar nas/ tsa pho/ tsha ma ning*/ dza mo yig dang*/ wa ni gong gi ba dang sbyar bar bya bas mo dang*/ de bzhin du lhag ma zha za 'a ya sha sa drug ni mo ru sbyar zhing*/ ra la ha ni mo gsham ste/ ma ning mtshan med ces kyang bya la/ a yig ni rtags med pas phyogs lhung du ma bzhag la/ 'on kyang spyi btang pho yin no/ /pho mo ma ning gsum du 'byed pa'i tshe/ mo dang shin tu mo gnyis mor 'du la/ ma ning mtshan med kyang ma ning du 'du'o/ /sdom ni/ ka ca ta pa tsa rnams pho/ kha cha tha pha tsha ma ning*/ /ga ja da ba dza wa zha/ /za 'a ya sha sa rnams mo/ /nga nya na ma shin tu mo/ /ra la ha rnams mo gsham mo/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa sngon 'jug gi 'jug pa bshad pa la gsum/ thun mong du sngon rjes bsdu tshul/ sngon 'jug gi rtags kyi dbye ba/ de'i 'jug tshul rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ mo yi yi ge'i nang nas ni/ /'jug pa'i yi ge bcu dbyung bya/

/'jug pa bcu yi nang nas ni/ /sngon 'jug yi ge lnga dbyung bya/ /zhes pa ste/ mo yig ga ja da ba sogs bcu gnyis dang*/ nga nya na ma bzhi dang*/ ra la ha bsnan pas bcu dgu yod pa'i mo yi yi ge'i nang nas ni ga sogs rjes su 'jug pa'i yi ge bcu dbyung bar bya la/ rjes su 'jug pa bcu yi nang nas ni sngon 'jug gi yi ge lnga dbyung bar bya ste/ de dag ni bshad zin to/ /gnyis pa ni/ sngon 'jug yi ge lnga po la/ /pho dang ma ning mo dang ni/ /shin tu mo dang bzhi ru dbye/ /zhes pa ste/ sngon 'jug gi yi ge lnga po la/ pho dang ma ning dang*/ mo dang shin tu mo dang bzhi ru dbye bar bya ste/ de ni/ ba pho ga da gnyis ma ning*/ /'a mo ma ni shin tu mo/ /zhes 'byung ba ltar/ ba ni sngon 'jug gi pho yig yin pa sogs shes par bya ba'i phyir/ ba ming gzhi'i mo yin kyang*/ sngon 'jug gi pho yig tu mi 'gal ba'i tshul sogs shes par bya'o/ /gsum pa la gnyis/ dri bas mtshams sbyar ba dang*/ lan gyis rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ de dag re re'ang bzhi byed de/ gang la 'jug byed gang gis 'jug/ji ltar 'jug byed ci phyir 'jug/zhes pa ste/ sngon 'jug lnga po de dag re re'ang bzhi bzhi byed de/ de'i tshul ni ming gzhi gang la 'jug par byed pa/ yi ge gang gis 'jug par byed pa/ sgra don gyi tshul ji ltar 'jug par byed pa/ dgos pa ci'i phyir du 'jug par byed pa yin zhes dri ba bzhi'i sgo nas mtshams sbyar ba'o/ /gnyis pa la bzhi/ gang la 'jug pa/ gang gis 'jug pa/ ji ltar 'jug pa/ ci'i phyir 'jug par byed pa bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ gzhi gang la 'jug pa dang*/ mi 'jug pa bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ gang la 'jug par byed ce na/ /pho ni pho dang mo la 'jug /mo ni mo dang ma ning la'o/ /ma ning yang ni pho mo la'o/ /shin tu mo ni ma ning dang*/ /mo dang shin tu mo nyid la'o/ /zhes pas lan bstan pa ste/

sngon 'jug de dag ming gzhi'i yi ge gang gi sngon la 'jug par byed ce na/ sngon 'jug gi pho ba yig ni/ ming gzhi'i pho ka ta tsa gsum gyi sngon du rgyang brtsegs gnyis ka'i sgo nas 'jug cing*/ ca la rkyang 'phul kho nas 'jug pa dang*/ mo ga da gnyis la rkyang brtsegs gnyis ka dang*/ zha za sha sa bzhi la rkyang 'phul kho nas 'jug /sngon 'jug gi mo 'a yig ni/ ming gzhi'i mo ga ja da pa dza lnga dang*/ ma ning kha cha tha pha tsha lnga ste bcu la rkyang 'phul kho nas 'jug pa'o/ /sngon 'jug gi ma ning ga yig yang ni/ pho ca ta tsa gsum dang*/ mo nya da na zha za ya sha sa brgyad de bcu gcig la 'jug pa'o/ /sngon 'jug gi shin tu mo ma yig ni/ ming gzhi'i ma ning kha cha tha tsha bzhi dang*/ mo ga da ja dza bzhi dang*/ shin tu mo nga nya na gsum bcas nyid la rkyang 'phul kho na'i sgo nas 'jug pa'o/ /sdom ni/ ba yig sngon 'jug pho yig las/ /ming gzhi'i pho yig ga ca dang*/ /ta tsa mo yig ga da zha/ /za sha sa na ra la'o/ /mo yig 'a ni ming gzhi yi/ /mo yig ga ja da ba dza/ /ma ning kha cha tha pha tsha/ /ma ning ga ni pho ta ca/ /tsa dang mo yig da zha za/ /ya sha sa na nya la'o/ /ma ning da ni pho ka pa/ /mo yig ga da ba ma sogs/ /shin tu mo yig ma nyid ni/ /ma ning kha cha tha tsha mo/ /ga ja da dza nga nya na'o/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa la/ mi 'jug pa ni 'di lta ste/ /pho ni ma ning la mi 'jug /mo yang pho la 'jug mi 'gyur/ /ma ning rang la rang mi 'jug /rang gi sde dang phrad pa na/ /pho yang mo la 'jug mi 'gyur/ /ma ning mo yang de bzhin no/ /zhes pa ste/ sngar bshad pa de dag las sngon du mi 'jug pa ni 'di lta ste/ sngon 'jug gi pho ba yig ni/ ming gzhi'i ma ning kha cha tha tsha rnams la mi 'jug pa dang*/ sngon 'jug gi mo yig 'a yang ni ming gzhi'i pho ka ca ta pa tsa la 'jug par mi 'gyur la/ sngon 'jug gi ma ning ga da gnyis ni ming gzhi'i ma ning rang sde kha cha tha pha tsha rnams la rang nyid mi 'jug cing*/

bzhi tshan du gnas pa'i rang gi sde pa dang phrad pa na sngon 'jug gi pho ba yang ming gzhi'i mo la 'jug par mi 'gyur te/ ba yig ni/ ba yig gi sngon du mi 'jug pa bzhin no/ /sngon 'jug gi ma ning ga yig pho ka dang mo ga nga gnyis dang ma ning da yig ni pho ta dang mo na la mi 'jug cing*/ sngon 'jug gi mo 'a yi yi ge yang*/ mo za ba ma gsum la mi 'jug pa sngar bshad pa de bzhin no/ /zhes so/ /de bzhin zhes pa sngon du drangs na bde mod/ 'dir mthar chags su bshad pa ni rtsa ba'i go rim dang bstun pa ste/ de yang tshig zin ltar go bde ba'i ched du'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ gang gis 'jug pa ni/ gang gis lnga po de dag gis/ / zhes pa zhig don gyis thob kyang*/ 'dir mi 'byung ba ni/ kha cig bstan pa 'phel 'grib kyi dbang gis chad par bzhed la gzhan dag ni/ gong gi pho ni zhes dang*/ mo ni dang*/ ma ning yang ni dang*/ shin tu mo ni zhes pa rnams kyis bsdoms te bstan par 'dir ma bshad ces bzhed do/ /gsum pa ji ltar 'jug pa ni/ ji ltar 'jug par byed ce na/ /pho ni drag po'i tshul gyis te/ /ma ning ran par 'jug pa yin/ /mo ni zhan pa'i tshul gyis te/ /shin tu mo ni mnyam pa'o/ /zhes pas ston te/ de yang sngon 'jug lnga po des sgra'i nga ro ji ltar 'jug par byed ce na/ lan du pho ni 'jig rten na skyes pa skad kyi nga ro mtho ba bzhin du sgra drag por brjod pa'i tshul gyis 'jug la/ ma ning ni skad gdangs ran par 'jug pa yin zhing*/ de bzhin du mo ni skad gdangs zhan pa'i tshul gyis 'jug pa yin te/ shin tu mo ni skad gdangs drag zhan mnyam pa'i tshul gyis 'jug pa'o/ /bzhi pa dgos pa ci'i phyir du 'jug par bshad pa la gnyis/ dri bas mtshams sbyar ba dang*/ lan gyis rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ ci phyir 'jug par byed ce na/ zhes pa ste/ sngon 'jug de rnams dgos pa ci'i phyir du 'jug par byed ce na zhes 'dri ba'o/

/gnyis pa la bzhi/ pho'i 'jug pa/ ma ning gi mo'i/ shin tu mo'i 'jug pa bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ pho ni 'das dang gzhan bsgrub phyir/ zhes pa ste/ pho'i yi ge ba ni/ dus 'das pa dang*/ gzhan bya ba bsgrub pa'i phyir du 'jug ces pa'o/ /'di ni tshig nyung la don rgyas pa zhig ste/ 'di'i skabs kyi 'das pa la mi mthun pa med kyang*/ gzhan zhes pa'i don la mi mthun pa 'ga' re byung ngo*/ /gang ltar yang bya ba bzhi la yod pa'i las yin pas na/ gzhan zhes brjod pa yin gy-i/ gang zag la bdag gzhan gnyis su phye ba'i gzhan tsam la ni mi byed do/ /'o na bya ba gzhi la yod pa'i las zhes pa'i don gang yin zhe na/ dper na/ sta res shing gcod pa ni/ gang zag dang sta re la yod pas byed pa sogs yod pa'i las yin la/ sta res shing bcad pa ni/ shing la yod pas bya ba gzhi la yod pa'i las su 'jog pa sogs mang ngo*/ /dper brjod na/ ba yig 'das pa la 'jug pa ni/ chu bkag go /snod bkang ngo*/ /logs su bkar/ khral bkal/ dum bur bkas/ ri mor bkod/ zur du bkol/ thags pas bkyigs/ chos bklags/ gos bkab/ dri ma bkrus/ sa brkos/ lag pa brkyangs/ snum bskus/ chos kyis bskyangs/ chu bskyil/ thugs dam bskangs/ mtsho bskams/ phyir bskrad/ rtar bskyon/ rkang pa bskums/ chos bgyis so/ /skor ba bskor ro zhes pa lta bu dang*/ grangs su bgrangs so/ /mig bgrad do/ /nor bgos/ gri brgyab zin/ dran med du brgyal/ mig tu brgyus/ rgyan gyis brgyan/ rim par brgyud/ lam bsgrags/ rigs bsgres/ 'jigs las bsgral/ chos bsgrags/ lha bsgoms/ rig pa bsgrims/ nor bsgrubs/ mdog bsgyur zin/ gral la bsgrigs/ bsgyel zin/ bka' bsgos/ skyon gyis bsgribs so/ /dbugs brngubs zin/ mchod pas brngan/ gtor ma bsngos/ bstod pas bsngags/ mtshang nas bsngogs/ zhabs kyis bcags/ snod du bcugs zin/ lam bcos/ khrims bcas/ gris bcad/ bre la bcal/ phyir bcil/

nyes pa bcabs/ rtar bcibs/ shing bcags/ mig bcar/ thags pas bcings/ las bcol/ dgra sde bcom/ gtan du bcags/ chu bcus/ phan tshun brjes/ brjod zin to/ /brjed do/ /rjes su bsnyegs so/ /gos brnyings so/ /go 'phang brnyes/ gzhan gyis brnyas/ gos brnyings/ lag pas bsnyabs/ 'phrad la bsnyal/ gzhan la bsnyad/ rjes su bsnyegs/ rab tu bsnyengs/ nor gyis bsnyems/ snyun gyis bsnyun/ mar bsnyugs so/ /phyir bsnyil to/ /gris btubs so/ /gyen du btegs so/ /mgo bos btud/ /mtshon btab/ rgyan btags/ rtsad nas bton/ /sbyin pa btang*/ stan bting*/ me tog btus/ legs par brtags/ lus brtas/ rnag brtol to/ sku bltams so/ /mig gis bltas so/ /gos bltabs/ /sa gzhi bstar zin/ zas bstabs/ bla ma bsten zin/ chos bstan/ bstod do/ /bstims so/ /rjes bdas/ spaus bdugs/ gzhu bdungs/ rnga brdungs so/ /mdun du bdar/ gri brdar ro/ /chal mar brdal zin/ slar bldabs/ skyo ma bldags/ sems bsdams/ grogs dang bsdongs/ dbang du bsdus/ mnyam du bsdebs/ dgra la bsdos/ gzhan la bsdigs/ phan tshun brdur ro/ /stan la bsdad/ phye ba bsdums/ yid du brnags so/ /zas kyis brnangs/ rdzas la brnabs/ phyag tu bsnams so/ /snon mar bsnan/ nor btsal to/ /bu btsas/ sha btsos/ chang btsags/ gos btsems/ nor btsongs/ dam du btsir/ snod du btsud/ mig btsums/ shing btsugs/ tho btsams/ sha btsabs sogs dang*/ de bzhin du/ brtsegs/ brtsams/ brtsigs/ brtsis/ brtses/ brtsad/ brjes/ bzhes/ bzhengs/ bzhar/ bzhag/bzhugs/ bzhud/ bzhogs/ bzabs/ bzas/ bzung ngo*/ /bzed/ bzi/ bzlas/ bzlums/ bzlog /brlobs/ brlag go /brlan to/ bshus/ bshig /bshal/ bshol/ bshar/ bshags/ bshad/ bshams/ bsags/ bsangs/ bsams/ bsad/ bsabs/ bsal/ bsubs/ bsres/ bsrings/ bsregs/ bsrubs/ bsrungs/ bslad/ bslan/ bslabs/ bslangs sogs so/ /de yang chos bshad/ dgra bsad/ sdig pa bshags pa lta bu ni 'das pa la 'jug mod/ bya ba da lta ba la'ang skabs stobs kyis 'jug ste/

bshad par bya ba sogs kyi don yin na/ 'das pa la mi 'jug pa'i phyir ro/ / bya ba gzhan bsgrub pa la 'jug pa ni/ rnam par bkra/ sman bku/ spa bkong*/ snod bkang bar bya/ chos bklag par bya/ mdud pa bkrol bar bya/ de bzhin du bya ba la sbyar te/ dri ma bkru/ 'dod la brkam/ nor brku/ sa brko/ re ba bskang*/ zhabs bskums/ mtsho bskyil/ nor bskyi/ snum bsku/ las bgyid/ mig bgrad/ nor bgo /tshod bgam/ chos bgyi/ bka' bgro/ 'phrang du bsgug /'od bsgrib/ lha bsgrub/ don bsgom/ gral bsgrig /bka' bsgo/ rgyal mtshan bsgreng*/ rigs bsgre/ phyi ru bsgyel/ btsas ma brnga/ du ba brngub/ gtor ma bsngo/ dgra bcom/ las bcol/ chu bcu/ khrims bca'/ gtam brjod pa/ phan tshun brje/ brje bar bya/ lag pas brnyog /phyi bsnyil ba/ lha bsnyen/ gyen du bteg bya/ me tog btu/ yin min brtag bya/ zhabs brtan/ lus brtas/ lag tu bstar/ bla ma bsten/ chos bstan/ bstod/ bstim/ bstir/ bstud/ blta/ bltam/ bltos pa/ bdar ba/ bdug pa/ bda'/ brdung*/ brdar/ brdeg bya/ blta ba/ bsdam/ bsdu/ bsngo/ bsdeb/ bsdig /brdeg /brnan/ bsnun/ bsnur/ bsnan/ bsnol/ btsong*/ btsan/ btsun/ btso/ brtsi/ brtson/ brtse/ brtsad par bya/ brtsig /brtsam/ brtse/ brdze/ brdzi/ brdzu/ brdzun/ bzhu/ bzheng*/ bzhed/ bzhud/ bzho/ bzab/ bza'/ bzed/ bzod/ bzla/ brlan/ brlag /brlab/ brlam/ bshu bsho bsher/ bsu/ bsam/ bsal bya/ bsil/ bsrong*/ bsreg bsre/ bsrung*/ bslab par bya ba sogs so/ /mdor na/ 'das pa dang gzhan gyi dpe ni/ bsgrubs zin pa dang bsgrub par bya/ drin gyis bskyangs pa bskyang bar bya/ dpon du bskos dang bsko bar bya/ /nor brkus pa dang brku bar bya/ /bsgral nas gzhan dag bsgral bar bya/ /legs par bsgoms zin bsgom par bya/ /bsgyur zin pa dang bsgyur rgyu dang*/ /phreng ba brgyus dang brgyu bar bya/ /btsas sogs brngas dang brnga ba dang*/ /de skad brjod zin brjod par bya/ /sogs gsungs pa ltar ro/

/gnyis pa ma ning dgos pa ci'i phyir 'jug pa ni/ ma ning gnyis ka da lta ched/ /ces pa ste/ sngon 'jug gi ma ning ga da gnyis ni/ bdag gam byed pa po la yod pa'i las dang*/ gzhan nam bya ba gzhi la yod pa'i las gnyis ka dang*/ dus da lta ba ston pa'i ched du 'jug ste/ de'ang ga yig bdag la 'jug pa ste/ rang nyid gcig pu/ yid gcugs pa/ gces pa/ gce bu/ gnyid log pa/ kha gdangs pa/ gdong pa/ zhe gnong pa/ gnas lugs/ yid gzhungs/ blo gzhol/ gzu bo/ gzi mdangs/ g.yeng ba/ g.yel ba/ gsus pa/ gsong po sogs dang*/ gzhan la 'jug pa ni/ me tog gcal du bkram/ gcong du lhung*/ rnam par gcod/ gcad bya'i shing*/ mjal ba'i gnyen/ gnyer pa/ chu'i gting*/ nor gyi gter/ gtar ka /gdan/ gdengs ka gnag pa/ gnad don/ gnas/ gtsang*/ gtsigs/ gtsags/ gzhal/ gzhung*/ gzhi/ gzan/ gzar/ gzi/ g.ya'/ g.yu/ g.yi/ gshegs/ gshags/ gshang*/ gsung*/ gsil/ gson sogs so/ /da lta ba la 'jug pa ni/ gcod/ gcog /gcal/ gnyug / gnyen/ gtong*/ gtor/ gtog /gdon/ gdags/ gdul/ gnong*/ gnon/ gnang*/ gtsigs/ gtse/ gtsag /gzhal/ gzhol/ gzhug /gzo/ gzims/ gzug /g.yog /g.yeg /g.yeng*/ gshol/ gsham/ gsher/ gsung*/ gsil/ gsigs sogs so/ /de dag ni mtshon byed tsam yin gyi/ ga yig bdag gzhan gnyis ka la 'jug pa'i gzhi ni mi 'gal te/ zha lu chen pos bdag gzhan gnyis ka la 'jug pa'i dpe lhan cig tu bstan pa ni/ gtan tshigs gtam gtong bsam gtan dang*/ gtang rag don gnyer gnyen po dang*/ kha gsag gsog 'jog gsus pa dang*/ sems gdug skad gdangs lus gnad dang*/ /gzhan lugs rnam gzhag gzhal med khang*/ /g.yas g.yon g.yang dag g.yul 'gyed sogs/ /zhes so sor ma phye bar bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /da lta ba la 'jug tshul ni/ go bde bar byas na/ gcod/ gtong*/ gnon/ gsod/ gtog /gdol/ gzhug /gzug lta bu ni/ da lta ba gtso che ba yin la/ gcad/ gzhal/ gding*/ gdags/ gdab/ gdul/ gdeg /gdon sogs ma 'ongs pa la'ang 'jug par bshad do/

/da yig bdag la 'jug pa ni/ lus kyi dku /dkyus/ dkan/ dgyes/ dka'/ dngangs/ dpral/ dpyi/ dbu sogs dang*/ gzhan la 'jug pa ni/ dkon mchog /dkor/ dkyil 'khor/ dkrugs/ dga'/ dge ba/ dgun/ dngos po/ dngul/ dngar/ dpe/ dbon/ dpung*/ dbul/ dbang*/ dbyi/ dbyar/ dbo/ dman/ dma'/ dmu lta bu dang*/ da lta ba la 'jug pa ni/ dkrogs/ dkrigs/ dkyus/ dgom/ dges/ dgod/ dpag /dpyad/ dbab/ dbul/ dbub/ dmyugs/ dmigs/ dmod sogs so/ /zha lu pas/ dge ba/ dga' ba/ dgos pa sogs rang gzhan gnyis ka la sbyar du rung ba'i sgra rnams yin la/ da lta ba la 'jug pa ni/ dgongs su gsol ba dang*/ zhes dper mdzad pas/ da yig rang gzhan gnyis ka la dus gcig tu 'jug pa mi 'gal zhing*/ da lta ba la'ang bdag gzhan gnyis ka'i 'jug pa ni/ yod de/ dgang ba dang*/ dgug pa/ dgram pa/ dgrol ba/ dgrod pa/ dbul ba/ dbab pa/ dpug pa/ dbrog pa/ dbye ba/ dbyung ba sogs bya ba'i yul ma 'ongs pa la 'jug pa gtso che bar bshad do// gsum pa mo yig gi 'jug pa ni/ mo ni bdag dang ma 'ongs phyir/ /zhes pa ste/ mo yig 'a ni/ dngos po bdag dang*/ dus ma 'ongs pa ston pa'i phyir 'jug pa gtso che zhing*/ bdag gzhan gnyis ka la'ang 'jug pa yod kyang*/ 'dir bdag gi khongs su bsdus te/ dper brjod pa ni/ 'khar rnga/ 'khar ba/ ngag 'khyal/ 'gong po/ 'gro ba/ 'go ba/ 'chal ba/ 'chus pa/ 'jug pa/ 'jam pa/ 'thar pa/ 'then pa/ 'thug pa/ 'das pa/ 'dun pa/ 'dod pa/ 'khyis pa/ 'khyag pa/ 'phro ba/ 'byor ba/ 'byung ba/ 'byid pa/ 'tshal pa/ 'tshub pa/ 'tshar ba/ 'dzag pa/ 'dzad pa/ 'dzin pa sogs so/ /dus ma 'ongs pa ston pa ni/ skud pa 'khal ba/ 'khrid pa/ 'khril ba/ 'grub pa/ 'grel pa/ 'gyur ba/ 'chi/ 'chel/ 'chol/ 'jab/ 'jol/ 'jug /'then/ 'thud/ 'dun/ 'dod/ 'dren/ 'phya/ 'phro/ 'phyang*/ 'bul/ 'byed/ 'byog /'tshal/ 'tshe/ 'tshong*/ 'dzad/ 'dzud/ 'dzul sogs so/ /'on kyang 'tshal/ 'dzal/ 'dod sogs ni spyir dus gsum ka la 'jug cing*/ 'dzad par 'gyur/

'tsha' khar 'gyur/ zhes pa ni ma 'ongs pa nyid do// bzhi pa shin tu mo'i 'jug pa ni/ shin tu mo ni mnyam phyir ro/ /zhes pa ste/ shin tu mo ma yig ni dngos po bdag gzhan gnyis dang*/ dus gsum mnyam pa nyid la 'jug pa'i phy-ir te/ de yang bdag gzhan gnyis la mnyam par 'jug pa ni/ mkhan po/ nam mkha'/ mkhar/ mkhal ma/ mgar ba/ mgrin pa/ mgul pa/ mngon pa/ mngon shes/ mnga' bdag mchan/ mchu/ mching bu/ mnyes pa/ gru mnyan/ mthong ba/ mthun/ mthol/ mda'/ mdung*/ mdos/ mno/ mnan/ mna' ma/ mtshan/ mtshon/ mtshungs/ mdzes/ mdzod/ mdzo sogs so/ /dus gsum mnyam pa nyid la 'jug pa ni/ de la mkhas so/ / mkhas/ mkhas par 'gyur zhes pa lta bu ste/ de bzhin du/ mtshungs/ mtshon/ mthong*/ mnyan/ mgu/ mjal/ mthun/ mnyes/ mdzes sogs kyang ngo*/ /chos mnyan par bya zhes pa ni bya ba da lta ba yin par mkhas pa phal che bzhed la/ zha lu ba chen pos ni/ bya ba ma 'ongs par bzhed par gsal lo/ /'on kyang*/ brjod pa po'i bsam don gtso che ba'i phyir na/ spyir gnyis ka la'ang 'jug par gsal bas/ 'gal ba'ang min no/ /spyir dus gsum la 'jug pa/ bcad dang gcod dang gcad pa dang*/ bcal dang 'jal byed gzhal ba dang*/ btings dang 'ding dang gding ba dang*/ btags dang 'dogs dang gdags pa dang*/ btab dang 'debs dang gdab pa dang*/ /btul dang 'dul dang gdul ba dang*/ / btegs dang 'degs dang gdeg pa dang*/ /btang dang gtong dang gtang ba dang*/ /bton dang 'don dang gdon pa dang*/ /bshig dang 'jig dang gzhig pa dang*/ /bcil dang 'jil dang gzhil ba dang*/ /bcom dang 'jom dang gzhom pa dang*/ /bzhags dang 'jog dang gzhag pa dang*/ /bcugs dang 'jug dang gzhug pa dang*/ /btsugs dang 'dzug dang gzug pa dang*/ /bzung dang 'dzin dang gzung ba dang*/ /bsad dang gsod dang gsod pa dang*/ /zhes pa lta bu ste/ /de yang*/ 'das da lta ma 'ongs pa gsum rim pa ltar ston par bshad/ /de dag ni zha lu pa chen pos gsungs pa 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa gos bsgyur ba ma gtogs de bzhin du bkod pa'o/

/gzhan bya ba'i sgra la o yis sbyar ba byed las dang*/ ma sbyar ba bya ba gzhi la yod pa'i las te/ de yang*/ lag pa rkyong par byed/ brkyang par bya/ chos klog par byed/ bklag par bya/ skrod par byed/ bskrad par bya/ skong bar byed/ bskang bar bya/ skyong bar byed/ bskyang bar bya/ sgrog par byed/ bsgrag par bya/ de bzhin du/ sgog /bsgag /sgrol/ bsgral/ rgol/ brgal/ rgyob/ brgyab/ gcog /bcag /snyog /bsnyab/ gtong*/ btang*/ gtod/ bstad/ rtog /brtag /ston/ bstan/ stod/ bstod/ rtsod/ brtsad/ slong*/ bslang*/ slob/ bslab/ rlabs/ brlabs sogs dang*/ yang*/ spyod/ spyad/ spong*/ spang*/ sbyong*/ sbyang*/ longs/ langs/ sprod/ sprad/ shod/ bshad sogs dang*/ yang bsgrub bya bsgrub par bya/ bgom bya bsgom par bya/ bsam bya bsam par bya/ zhes pa lta bu'i snga ma ming dang*/ phyi ma bya ba'o/ /skyongs shig /sgrubs shig /sgoms shig lta bu bskul ba'i tshig yin pas bas 'phul med la/ bsgrub bya sogs la bas 'phul yod cing sa mtha' med/ bsgrubs so/ /bsgoms so/ /brlabs so lta bu la bas 'phul dang sa mtha'ang thob po/ /gsum pa rjes 'jug gi rtags kyi 'jug pa rgyas par bshad pa la gnyis te/ rtags kyi dbye ba bshad pa dang*/ 'jug tshul bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rjes 'jug yi ge bcu po la/ /pho mo ma ning gsum du dbye/ /pho la skyes bu rab 'bring gsum/ /mo la mo dang shin tu mo/ /ma ning 'gyur dang mtshan gnyis dang*/ /mtshan med dag dang gsum du 'dod/ /zhes pa ste/ de ltar rjes 'jug gi yi ge bcu po 'di dag la'ang nang gses kyi sgo nas pho mo ma ning gsum du dbye zhing*/ pho la'ang skyes bu rab 'bring tha ma gsum dang*/ mo la mo tsam dang shin tu mo gnyis dang*/ ma ning la 'gyur ba ma ning dang mtshan gnyis ma ning dang*/ mtshan med ma ning dag dang gsum du 'dod do ces so/ /'di la mkhas pa rnams kyi bzhed pa mi mthun pa mang na'ang*/ rje zha lu pas da ba sa gsum rjes 'jug gi pho dang*/

'a dang ra gnyis mo dang*/ ga da na ma la rnams ma ning du byas nas/ da ba sa gsum rim pa bzhin du skyes bu rab 'bring tha gsum du byas pa'i pho/ mo la mo tsam dang shin tu mo gnyis te 'a dang ra'o/ /ma ning la gsum gyi 'gyur ba ma ning ni ga nga na gsum dang*/ mtshan gnyis pa ma dang mtshan med la yig tu bzhed cing*/ za ma tog tu ga yig kyang phor bstan ces kha cig bzhed de gang ltar yang re zhig de ltar ram rnam gling pa bzhin bya'o/ /gnyis pa la gnyis/ dri bas mtshams sbyar ba dang*/ lan gyis rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ de yang byed pa bzhi byed de/ /gang la 'jug byed gang gis byed/ /ji ltar 'jug byed ci phyir byed/ /zhes pa ste/ sngon 'jug du ma zad rjes 'jug de yang byed pa bzhi bzhi byed de/ bzhi ni gang la 'jug par byed pa dang*/ ngo bo gang gis 'jug par byed pa dang*/ tshul ji ltar 'jug par byed pa dang*/ dgos pa ci'i phyir du 'jug par byed pa rnams so/ /gnyis pa la bzhi/ gang la/ gang gis/ ji ltar/ ci'i phyir 'jug par bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ gang la yi ge thams cad la/ /zhes gsungs te/ rjes 'jug gi yi ge bcu po ni yi ge gang la 'jug na 'di dag gi sngon 'jug dang mi 'gal bar yi ge thams cad la 'jug go /gnyis pa ni/ gang gis bcu po de dag gis/ /zhes pa ste/ yi ge gang gis 'jug na rjes 'jug bcu po de dag gis 'jug par byed do/ /'dir gang gi zhes drug sgra sbyar ba ni ma dag par gsal lo/ /gsum pa la gnyis/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ ji ltar rnam pa gnyis yin te/ sgra yi 'jug tshul don gyi tshul/ /zhes pa ste/ ji ltar 'jug tshul la rnam pa gnyis yod pa yin te/ brjod byed sgra'i sgo nas 'jug tshul dang*/ brjod bya don gyi sgo nas 'jug tshul lo/ /gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la sgra don gnyis kyi dang po la gsum/ drag zhan spyi'i 'jug tshul/

nang gses kyi 'jug tshul/ ma ning gi 'jug tshul rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ pho gsum mo gnyis ma ning gsum/ /drag zhan bar ma gsum du 'jug /zhes pa ste/ pho la skyes bu rab 'bring tha gsum dang mo la mo tsam dang shin tu mo gnyis/ ma ning 'gyur ba dang mtshan gnyis dang mtshan med dang bcas pa gsum po ni rim pa bzhin du pho gsum drag po'i tshul dang*/ mo gnyis zhan pa'i tshul dang ma ning bar ma'i tshul gsum du 'jug par byed do/ /gnyis pa ni/ drag pa gsum ni nang phrad dam/ gal te zhan pa nang 'phrad na/ /de la nang gi cha shas kyis/ /de yang drag zhan gnyis su dbye/ /zhes pas ston te/ de yang sngon 'jug dang*/ ming gzhi dang*/ rjes 'jug phor phrad pa/ drag pa gsum ni nang phrad dam yang gal te sngon 'jug dang rjes 'jug drag la ming gzhi rang gi sde tshan mo yig zhan pa nang phrad pa lta bu dang*/ de bzhin du sngon 'jug dang ming gzhi drag la rjes 'jug zhan pa lta bu dang*/ ming gzhi rjes 'jug drag la sngon 'jug zhan pa dang sngon 'jug drag la ming rjes zhan pa dang*/ sngon ming zhan la rjes 'jug drag pa dang*/ sngon rjes zhan la ming gzhi drag pa dang*/ gsum gzhan pa nang 'phrad pa lta bur gyur na/ de la'ang so so'i nang gi khyad par ram nang gses kyi cha shas kyis/ drag pa de la yang drag pa'i drag pa dang*/ drag pa'i zhan pa gnyis/ zhan pa la'ang de gnyis su dbye bar bya'o/ /zhes so/ /de la drag pa gsum nang 'phrad pa ni/ bkal/ bcad/ bcab dang*/ ga phor byas na/ bkag /ces dang*/ bcad/ bcas/ btab/ btags/ btsad/ btsab/ btsud/ btsag lta bu drag pa'i drag pa dang*/ bgad/ bgab/ bgos/ bgug sogs sngon rjes drag la ming gzhi zhan pa dang*/ bkar/ bkal/ bkang*/ bkan/ bskam lta bu sngon ming drag la rjes 'jug zhan pa dang*/ gcod/ bcags/ gcus/ gtad/ gtud sogs ming rjes drag la sngon 'jug zhan pa ni drag pa'i zhan pa dang*/ bgrang*/ bgam/ brngon/ brngam/ brkang lta bu sngon 'jug drag la ming rjes zhan pa dang*/

gcung*/ gcen/ gcur/ gtong*/ gtam sogs sngon rjes zhan la ming gzhi drag pa dang*/ gnyags/ gnyod/ gnyis/ gdags/ gdab lta bu sngon ming zhan la rjes 'jug drag pa rnams ni zhan pa'i drag pa dang*/ gnyong*/ gnyen/ gnyer/ gnyal/ gdags/ gdam sogs zhes pa sogs nang 'phrad pa'i zhan pa'i zhan pa rnams shes par bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ ma ning gsum du gang gtogs pa/ /drag dang 'phrad na drag par 'gyur/ /zhan dang phrad na zhan par 'gyur/ /gnyis ka dang ni phrad gyur na/ /de ni gnyis ka can du 'gyur/ /gnyis ka dang ni ma phrad na/ /gang du yang ni mi 'gyur ro/ /des na 'gyur dang mtshan gnyis dang*/ /mtshan med ma ning gsum du 'dod/ /de ni sgra yi 'jug tshul lo/ /zhes pa ste/ ma ning gsum du grogs la bltos na gang du 'gyur bar gtogs pa'i yi ge ga the bar byas na ga da na gsum yin la/ ga phor byas na 'gyur ba ma ning nga na gnyis ni/ pho yig drag pa rnams dang phrad na drag par te pho yig tu 'gyur te/ rkang pa ston pa lta bu ste/ ga sbyar na/ rtag pa ces pa rnams so/ /de ni zha lu chen pos bzhed pa ste/ rnam gling pas 'gyur ba ma ning ni 'a yig la mdzad nas/ dper brjod du/ bka'/ bca'/ bcab lta bu dang*/ drag pa dang phrad na drag pa dang*/ 'ga'/ 'dza'/ mda'/ mnga' zhes pa lta bu zhan pa dang phrad na zhan par 'gyur bar bshad do/ /zhan pa mo yig dang phrad na zhan par 'gyur te/ zha lu pa ltar na/ mthong ngo*/ /yin no lta bu dang rnam gling pas sngar ltar ro/ /pho mo gnyis ka'i rtags yod pa dang ni phrad par gyur na de ni pho mo gnyis ka'i rtags can du 'gyur te/ 'di la zha lus/ ma yig ma ning mtshan gnyis par byas nas/ de pho mo gnyis ka'i rtags yod pa/ bstims/ bskums/ brtsams zhes pa lta bu dang phrad par bzhed la/ rnam gling pas/ 'a yig 'gyur ba ma ning du byas pa de nyid/ rtags gnyis ka can dang phrad pa'i dper/ bza'/ bka'/ gta' zhes mdzad de mi mthun no/ /snga ma ltar na/

ra sa gnyis mo dang ka ta tsa gsum phor mdzad nas steng 'og gi dbang du byas la/ phyi ma ltar na sngon rjes ming gzhi gsum gyi dbang du mdzad de gang ltar yang mtshan gnyis par 'gyur tshul du bzhed do/ / drag zhan gnyis ka dag dang ma phrad na rtags gang du yang ni mi 'gyur ro/ /rgyu mtshan des na 'gyur ba ma ning dang mtshan gnyis dang*/ mtshan med kyi ma ning gsum du 'dod do/ /ji skad bshad pa de ni sgra yi 'jug tshul lo zhes so/ / 'dir zha lus la yig mtshan med ma ning du mdzad nas/ phyag 'tshal/ mkhal ma/ thal mo/ /'chal sogs la drag zhan gnyis ka'i rtags med par bzhed la/ rnam gling pas/ 'a yig ni kha cha tha pha tsha lta bu drag zhan gang rung gi rtags med pa dang phrad pas mtshan med ma ning du 'gyur bar bzhed pa ni mi 'dra ba'i khyad par ro/ /gnyis pa don gyi 'jug tshul la gnyis/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ don ni rnam pa gnyis yin te/ snga ma gang ltar gyur pa dang*/ /phyi ma gang ltar 'gyur ba'o/ /zhes pa ste/ don gyi 'jug tshul ni rnam pa gnyis yin te/ snga ma gang ltar 'jug par gyur pa dag phyi ma gang ltar 'gyur bar bshad pa'o/ /gnyis pa la gnyis kyi dang po ni/ snga ma gang ltar gyur pa ni/ /snga ma sngon 'jug lnga bzhin sbyar/ /zhes pa ste/ rjes 'jug bcu'i don gyi 'jug tshul yang ming ngam tshig snga ma gang ltar gyur pa ni snga ma sngon 'jug lnga'i skabs su ci'i phyir 'jug par bshad tshe/ pho ni 'das dang gzhan bsgrub phyir/ zhes pa nas/ shin du mo ni mnyam phyir ro/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis bshad pa bzhin du sbyar bar bya'o/ /de yang bya ba byas/ char bab/ na tsha chad/ chu bkag ces pa lta bu 'das pa la 'jug pa dang*/ sras/ srab/ srid/ srog lta bu dngos po gzhan dang*/ bshad par bya/ bsgrub par bya/ bsgom par bya lta bu bya ba da lta ba dang*/ brjod par byas/ bstan par byas/ bsam par byas lta bu bya ba 'das pa la 'jug pa dang*/

'byung*/ 'gyur/ 'dren sogs ma 'ongs pa ste rgyas par sngar sngon 'jug gi tshe bshad pa las shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa la gsum/ drag zhan gyi sgra mthun 'dren tshul/ rnam dbye snga phyi 'dren tshul/ nang gses dbye tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ phyi ma dag gis 'dren tshul ni/ pho yis pho yi ming mtha' drang*/ /mo yis mo yi mig mtha' drang*/ /ma ning gis ni ma ning ngo*/ /zhes pa ste/ rjes 'jug gi yi ge bcu po zhugs pa'i rjes su don gsal bar byed pa'i tshig phrad dang rnam dbye phyi ma dag gis 'dren tshul ni/ ming gzhi'i pho ka ca ta pa yis ni rjes 'jug gi pho da ba sa gsum dang ga yi ming mtha' can drang bar bya ste/ dper na/ dpyid ka thad ka thabs cig /rgyob cig dang*/ da drag gi dbang gis/ ston ka gyur cig /rol cig dang*/ gal te/ bsad te zhes kyang rung*/ btab cing*/ bkab cing*/ rtag ce na/ med ce na/ dag cing*/ mchog tu/ tshab tu/ rig cing*/ gcig pu/ skad cig /thams cad sogs dang*/ rig pa/ lhag pa/ dag pa/ phrag pa/ lag pa/ 'gog pa/ mchod pa/ bstod pa/ 'dod pa/ yod pa/ spyod pa/ chad pa/ grub pa/ thob pa/ btab pa/ 'bab pa/ khyab pa/ gdab pa/ rigs pa/ mdzes pa/ rgyas pa/ tshogs pa/ bsgoms pa/ dgos pa sogs mang ngo*/ /ming gzhi'i mo yis rjes 'jug gi mo yi ming mtha' can drang bar bya ste/ 'di la zha lu bas ming gzhi'i mo ma yig gis/ rjes 'jug gi mo'i ming mtha' can 'dren pa'i dper/ dga' ma/ gzar ma zhes mdzad la/ rnam gling pas/ byung ba/ snying ga /dgun ga tshor ba/ 'dul ba/ gang gi mdun gyi/ shar gyi/ 'byung du/ rgyun du/ zhal du/ drang zhing*/ 'jam zhing*/ 'tshal zhing*/ 'byung zhes/ yin zhes/ bsam zhes/ cung zhig /mthong zhe na sogs bshad pa gnyis las/ phyi ma khyab che bar mngon no/ /rjes 'jug gi ma ning gis ni ming gzhi'i ma ning gi ming mtha' drang ngo*/ /'di la'ang zha lu pas/ ga rjes 'jug gi ma ning du byas nas/ bdag gi /drug gi /lhas byin gyis sogs dper mdzad la/

rnam gling pas/ bka'/ bca'/ btsa'/ gca'/ gta'/ gtsa'/ dka'/ dpa'/ 'ga'/ 'cha'/ 'dza'/ 'da' sogs 'a yig ma ning du byas nas dper mdzad do/ /des na rnam gling pas bzhed pa ltar byas na/ sa skyes bu rab/ ba 'bring ga da gnyis tha/ nga na ma ra la ni mo/ 'a ni ma ning dang*/ mo la gnyis te/ ra la gnyis mo tsam dang nga na ma gsum shin tu mor bzhad par gsal bas lugs gnyis ka gang bde byas kyang rung ngo*/ /zha lu chen pos sum rtags kyi 'grel bar/ da ba sa gsum tsam phor bshad la/ za ma tog tu/ ga dang ba yi rjes su tu/ /zhes pas ga yig gis kyang ming gzhi'i pho ta 'dren par bzhed do/ /ming gzhi'i pho ni ka ca ta pa tsa rnams yin pas kyang kyi cing cig tu to te pu po rnams kyang pho'o/ /gnyis pa rnam dbye snga shugs 'dren tshul ni/ ming mtha' de dag nyid kyis ni/ de nyid rang gi sgra mthun pa'o/ /chos dngos las dang byed pa dang*/ sbyin dang 'byung khungs 'brel ba dang*/ /gnas dang bod pa'i sgra yang drang*/ /gzhan yang slar bsdu lhag bcas dang*/ /'byed sdud bsnan dang bdag po dang*/ /dgag sgrub rgyan dang dus la 'jug /de dag snga shugs 'dren pas 'byung*/ /zhes pas ston te ming mtha' de dag nyid kyis kyang ni ming mtha' de nyid rang gi sgra dang mthun pa'i rnam dbye dang tshig phrad rnams 'dren te chos dngos te dang po gzhi chos de dang de'i dngos po 'am ming tsam mam ngo bo tsam brjod pa/ gzhi gang du bya ba gang bya ba 'am byed par ston pa'i rnam dbye gnyis pa las su bya ba dang byed pa po gang gis bya ba gang byed par ston pa'i gsum pa byed pa po dang*/ don gang gi ched du bya ba gang byed par ston pa'i bzhi pa dgos ched kyi sbyin pa dang gzhi gang las gang zhig 'byung pa'am byung bar ston pa'i lnga pa 'byung khungs dang*/ bya ba gang gzhi gang gi yin par sgrub pa'am de dang 'brel bar ston pa'i drug pa 'brel ba dang*/ gang zhig gzhi gang la gnas par ston pa'i bdun pa gnas gzhi dang ming gi thog mar kye sbyar ba brgyad pa bod pa'i sgra yang drang zhing gzhan yang rnam dbye dang po'i yan lag slar bsdu dang*/

tshig phrad du gtogs pa lhag bcas dang 'byed sdud dang bsnan pa dang bdag po'i sgra dang dgag pa dang sgrub pa dang tshig rgyan dang dus te tshe skabs la'ang 'jug pa de dag ni snga shugs 'dren pa'i sgo nas 'byung bar 'gyur te rgyas par ni sngar rgya cher bshad pa las shes par bya'o/ /gsum pa nang gses kyi dbye ba ni gnyis te/ rnam dbye dang*/ tshig phrad do/ /dang po ni/ de dag nang gses gang 'jug pa/ /mthar sbyar 'og ma'i ming don las/ /spyir 'jug yod dam byed pa yod/ /de bzhin ched byed rten byed dang*/ /las bya blang bya bsgrub par bya/ /sngon du 'os pa gnas pa'am/ /zhes gsungs te/ bshad ma thag pa de dag nang gses kyis phye nas gang la 'jug pa ni ming tshig gi mtha' ma ru sbyar ba'i tshig 'og ma'i ming don las shes par bya ste de yang spyir 'jug gang zhes pa'am ci zhes pa lta bu yod na des nges bzung gi de zhes pa 'dren no dam zhes pa ni 'dam ka byed pa ste der ma nges pa'o/ /byed pa'i sgra kyis gyis gis lta bu yod na des bya byas zhes pa'i sgra 'dren pa dang de bzhin du bzhi pa dgos ched du byed pa dang*/ bdun pa rten byed dang*/ gnyis pa las su bya ba dang*/ lnga pa 'byung khungs kyi blang ba dang*/ drug pa 'brel ba bsgrub par bya ba dang*/ brgyad pa sngon du kye zhes 'os pa sbyar nas gnas shing yod pa gzhi de dang de la bod pa'i sgra 'chad 'gyur ltar yod pa rnams kyis ming mtha' 'dren tshul yang shes par bya'o/ /de yang gang gi ched du yod na de'i ched du'am/ 'di'i ched du lta bu 'dren pa sogs sngar sum cu pa las na bstan pa rnams so/ /gnyis pa ni/ gzhan yang tshig don 'og ma las/ /bsdu rgyu yod dam med pa dang*/ /gong ma las kyang de bzhin te/ /rnam grangs dag ni bkod pa las/ /bskyar ba yod dam med pa dang*/ /pho sgra dang ni mo sgra dag /ming gi mtha' na yod med dang*/ /rgyan du gyur pa rnams la yang*/

/don la snyegs pa yod med dang*/ /bstan bya lhag ma yod med dang*/ /tshig don rdzogs dang ma rdzogs kyi/ /de dag nang gses rnam par dbye/ /zhes pa ste/ gzhan yang tshig don 'og ma las bsdu rgyu yod dam med pa dang tshig don gong ma las kyang bsdu rgyu yod med de bzhin te bsdu rgyu yod pa ni gzugs nas rnam mkhyen gyi bar dang*/ gzugs sogs ces pa lta bu dang*/ bsdu rgyu med pa ni/ 'di ni gzugs so/ /'di ni tshor ba'o/ /bum pa'o/ /ka ba'o/ /yod de lta bu dang*/ gong ma bsdud pa ni/ ji snyed yod ce na de snyed ces pa dang*/ gang dang gang yin na de dang de yin dang*/ gang gi phyir zhe na/ de'i phyir zhes pa lta bu phyi mas snga mas sdud par ma zad phan tshun du sdud pa'i tshig go /ming gi rnam grangs dang ni bkod pa dar ba dang rgyas pa dang 'phel ba dang rdzogs pa lta bu dang*/ stong pa nyid dang zab mo dbu ma yi zhes pa lta bu rnams las tshig la bskyar ba dngos su med kyang don la bskyar ba yod dam med par brtag pa ste/ de yang legs so legs so/ /de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te dang*/ 'ur 'ur rab tu 'ur 'ur/ chem chem rab tu chem chem sogs tshig la dngos su bskyar yang*/ don che 'bring chung ngu'i khyad par gyis song bas bskyar ba med kyang*/ stong pa nyid dang zab mo zhes pa lta bu'i don la bskyar ba yod de/ rta pa/ ja pa/ tsha pa sogs pho sgra bdag po'i sgra dang ni skyon med pa/ 'jig pa med pa sogs mo sgra dag ming gi mtha' sogs na yod med dang*/ tshig rgyan du gyur pa sngar bshad pa gnyis las kyang 'ang yang rnams la yang don la bsnyegs pa yod med dang*/ de bzhin du/ kun tu/ rab tu/ yongs su/ rnam par/ thams cad/ mtha' dag /rnams/ kun lta bu re re'am zlos te byung ba rnams la yang*/ don la lhag pa snyegs pa yod med shes par bya zhing*/ yod do/ /yin no sogs dang*/ yod de/ yin te 'ong zhes pa lta bu'i bstan bya lhag ma yod med dang*/

lhag ma dang bcas ma bcas kyi dbang gis skabs kyi tshig don rdzogs dang ma rdzogs pa sogs kyi don rjes 'jug de dag gi nang gses kyi brjod bya phra zhib rnam par dbye bar bya'o/ /bzhi pa ci'i phyir 'jug pa bshad pa la gnyis/ yi ge'i khyad par spyir bstan pa dang*/ skabs don bshad pa'o/ /dang po la/ yi ge la sgras brjod rigs kyis dbye na gnyis te/ brdar btags pa'i yi ge dang*/ yi ge dngos so/ /dang po ni/ yi ge'i gzugs brnyan te/ rgya bod kyi dbyangs gsal gyi yi ge'i gzugs dang*/ gsung rab po tir mdzad pa'i yi ge rnams so/ /'di la dbu can dang dbu med kyi khyad par gnyis yod do/ /gnyis pa ni/ ming tshig gnyis kyi gzhi byed pa'i skad kyi gdangs zhig ste/ rkyen ni rang kun nas slong byed kyi shes pa zhig las skye'o/ /de ni rnam 'grel las/ yi ge kun slong shes pa las/ skye la shes pa'i sgra skye'o/ /zhes dang*/ de yang dpang los/ rnam rtog dbang gis rlung g.yos shing*/ /de yis gnas dang byed pa dang*/ /rtsol ba bskyed de dbugs dbyung dang*/ /lhan cig yi ge'i gdangs rnams skye/ /zhes 'byung ba ltar ro/ /des na ngag smra ba kun yi ge'i rang bzhin du gnas pa yin no/ /ming ni/ don gyi ngo bo tsam brjod pa thams cad de/ lha klu mi sogs re re nas brjod pa rnams dang*/ 'di la dngos ming dang btags ming gnyis/ btags ming la'ang rgyu ming 'bras/ 'bras ming rgyu/ spyi sgra bye brag /'dra ba 'brel ba rgyu mtshan du byas nas btags pa sogs mang ngo*/ /tshig ni ming gnyis phan chad 'dus pa zhig ste/ ka bas gdung bteg /bum pas dbang bskur zhes pa lta bu'o/ /ming dang brda'i khyad par yang*/ gang la thog mar ming btags pa'i tshe/ de la ming gis brda sbyar ba'ang yin la/ phyis de dang de zhes brjod pa dang 'dzin pa'i blo ni tha snyad ces bya ba yin no/ /brda dang tha snyad gnyis ni 'ga' ba yang ma yin te/

thog mar ming gis brda sbyar ba de dag tha snyad byas pa'ang yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'dir sgra don 'dzin pa'i rtog pa skye tshul zhig gsungs kyang*/ las dang po pa la de tsam du nye bar mi mkho ba'i phyir ma bris so/ /gnyis pa la gnyis/ dngos dang*/ 'phros don no/ /dang po ni/ ci phyir 'jug par byed ce na/ yi ge'i khongs na ming phyung ste/ /ming gi khongs nas tshig byung nas/ /tshig gis don rnams ston par byed/ /ces pa ste/ rjes 'jug de dag dgos pa ci'i phyir du 'jug par byed ce na/ zhes mtshams sbyar nas/ ming tshig gi don gsal bar byed pa ni sngon rjes ky-i yi ge la rag las so zhes ston par/ ka la sogs pa'i yi ge gnyis sam du ma 'dus pa'i khongs nas/ ka ba/ bum pa zhes sogs kyi ming phyung ste/ ming gnyis sam du ma 'dus pa dag gi khongs nas ni tsandan gyi ka ba dang*/ gser gyi bum pa zhes sogs kyi tshig phyung nas tshig gis don rnams ston par byed pa ste/ tsandan gyi ka bas btegs pa'i khang bzang gi steng na gser gyi bum pas rnam par mdzes zhes pa lta bu ngag gi 'phreng bar grub bo/ /'dir don rnams zhes pa zha lu chen pos rnam par zhes pa'i don du bshad do/ /gnyis pa la gnyis/ don gtso bor ston byed gang yin pa dang*/ de las ldog pa bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ mo yi yi ge med na ni/ /pho yig brjod par med par 'gyur/ /pho yig de dag rnams la yang*/ /'jug par bcas pa med par ni/ /ming dang tshig kyang gsal mi nus/ /ming tshig gsal ba med na ni/ /don rnams brjod par mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa ste/ ngag tu grub pa ni rjes 'jug la rag las pa nyid kyi phyir na mo yi yi ge rjes 'jug med na ni/ pho yig ka la sogs 'dus pa tsam zhig gis ni/ brjod pa'i don ston pa med par 'gyur zhing ming gzhi'i pho yig de dag rnams la yang*/ rjes su 'jug par bcas pa med par rkyang pa ga sogs re res ni/

ming dang tshig kyang gsal bar byed mi nus la/ ming dang tshig gsal bar brjod pa med na ni/ don rnams brjod pa yang mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes so/ kha dang*/ ja nya lta bu la rjes 'jug dngos su med kyang 'a yig don gyis 'thob tshul ni bshad zin to/ /'dir mo'i yi ge zhes smos pa ni/ rjes 'jug rnams spyir mo yig nang tshan yin pa la dgongs pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ de ltar gyur na 'jig rten na/ /don mtshon brjod pa kun kyang med/ /rig byed smra ba'ang yod mi 'gyur/ /nyan thos rang rgyal sangs rgyas kyi/ /bslab pa rnams kyang med par 'gyur/ /ji ltar 'jig rten sems can dag /phung po khams dang skye mched dang*/ /grub mtha' gzhan yang yod min na/ /rang nyid kyis ni mi shes bzhin/ /de bzhin yi ge'i 'jug tshul rnams/ /smra ba kun la gnas gyur kyang*/ /rang tshul de nyid mi shes pas/ /don la sbyor ba ga la shes/ /zhes pa ste/ gong du brjod pa de ltar gyur na 'jig rten na zo zhig /song zhig /'dug cig ces bya ba la sogs pa don mtshon pa'i brjod pa kun kyang med par 'gyur/ phyi rol pa'i rig byed bzhi smra ba'ang yod par mi 'gyur zhing*/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i nyan thos rang rgyal sangs rgyas kyi bslab pa rnams kyang med par 'gyur te/ dpe ji ltar na/ 'jig rten gyi khams na sems can dag la phung po dang*/ khams dang*/ skye mched dang*/ grub pa'i mtha' sogs gzhan yang yod mod kyang*/ 'di dang 'di 'o zhes brda ma sbyar bar thog ma nas rang nyid kyis mi shes pa bzhin no/ /rtsa ba 'dir min na zhes 'byung yang*/ gzhan du yod mod na zhes bshad pa ltar bya'o/ /de bzhin du yi ge'i 'jug tshul rnams/ smra ba kun la gnas par gyur kyang*/ 'di 'di'o zhes brda ma sbyar bar de dag gi khyad par rang rang gi gnas tshul de nyid legs par mi shes pas/ tshig 'dis don 'di ltar ston no zhes don la ji lta ba bzhin du sbyor ba ga la shes te mi shes so/

/rig byed bzhi ni brjod zin la/ phung po ni/ gzugs nas rnam shes kyi bar lnga dang*/ khams ni/ mig sogs dbang po'i khams drug/ gzugs sogs yul gyi khams drug /mig gi rnam par shes pa sogs rnam shes kyi bar gyi khams drug ste bco brgyad/ skye mched ni/ mig gi skye mched nas yid kyi skye mched kyi bar drug dang*/ gzugs kyi skye mched nas chos kyi bar drug ste bcu gnyis so/ /grub mtha' smra ba la rtsa ba'i sgo nas bzhi ste/ bye brag smra ba/ mdo sde pa/ sems tsam pa/ dbu ma pa'o/ /de dag kyang*/ nang pa'i dbang du byas la/ phyi nang so so'i dbye ba la'ang mang ngo*/ /gsum pa 'jug gi don ni/ de phyir smra ba'i dbang phyug gi /rjes smras 'di kun rtogs gyur cig /ces pa ste/ rgyu mtshan ji skad bshad pa de'i phyir na thu mi bdag gis ni 'dir/ 'jam dbyangs smra ba'i dbang phyug gi rjes su 'brang ste smras pa 'di'i don kun ni bod yul gyi skye bo rnams kyis rtogs par gyur cig ces so/ /dbang phyug gis zhes sa mtha' bris pa ni yig nor du mngon la/ 'di kun zhes pa'i don 'grel pa gzhan du bod yul gyi skye bo kun gyi zhes sbyar yang*/ kho bo'i bsam tshod ni sngar ltar te brtags par bya'o/ /byā ka ra ṇa sogs ni sla'o/ /smras pa/ yon tan kun gyi gzhi ma yi ge ste/ /rtsa ba dbyangs dang gsal byed rnam pa gnyis/ /de dag bod yig gzugs su gangs can du/ /thog mar gtan 'bebs thu mi las gzhan su/ /gang de'i bzhed srol sum rtags padmo'i kha/ /legs bshad snang ba'i zer gyis phye ba 'dir/ /don gnyer sbrang rtsi 'dzin pa'i rkang drug dag /dga' ba'i dar dir sgrogs bzhin 'jug par rigs/ / tshul 'dir 'bad pa las 'khrungs dge ba'i cha/ /ji snyed thob de mtha' dag 'gro ba kun/ /'chad bya 'chad byed don la thogs med pa'i/ /so so yang dag rig bzhi 'grub phyi bsngo/
